I almost got trapped in the human world. It was very stressful. And when I get home, even though I'm exhausted, I keep thinking about everything that happened. I can't relax, and I'm assailed by fears about what might happen next night.”

Dr. Owl said: “I understand. You have lived very intense experiences, and it is natural that your mind and body are still active when you go to sleep. Also, the fears you mention can increase your anxiety.”
Tommy the Tooth Mouse sighed: “Exactly. I worry that next time the cat will discover me, or that the magic door will close definitively and I won't be able to return to the forest.”
Dr. Owl smiled empathetically.

Dr. Owl said: “I have some advice that might help you fall asleep. First, it's important that you establish a relaxing routine before bed. When you return home, instead of going straight to bed, dedicate some time to quiet activities.”
Tommy the Tooth Mouse asked, interested: “Like what?”

Dr. Owl responded: “You could drink chamomile tea to relax. You could also read a book you like or listen to soft music. This will help your mind disconnect from the adventures and prepare for sleep.”
Tommy the Tooth Mouse commented: “I like the idea. I have a book about the calm of the forest that I always wanted to read in more detail.”
Dr. Owl said: “Excellent. Also, you could write your experiences and fears in a journal. Sometimes, putting what we feel on paper makes those emotions lose strength and allows us to free our minds.”
Tommy the Tooth Mouse said thoughtfully: “I have never kept a journal, but I think it could help me.”

Dr. Owl continued: “It is also helpful to practice breathing exercises. Inhale deeply counting to four, hold the air for four seconds, and exhale slowly counting to four. Repeat this several times; it will help your body to relax.”
Tommy the Tooth Mouse affirmed: “I will try it.”
Dr. Owl added: “And don't forget to create an environment conducive to sleep. Lowering the lights and avoiding loud noises can be of great help.”

That night, upon returning home after another exciting adventure in which he had to sail in a leaf through a pond to reach an isolated house 🚣‍♂️🍃, Tommy the Tooth Mouse decided to follow Dr. Owl's advice. He prepared chamomile tea 🍵 and sat in his favorite armchair to read about the quiet starry nights of the forest 🌌.
Then, he took a notebook and began to write in his journal:

“Today was an intense night. Sailing through the pond was challenging, but I made it. However, I'm still worried about encountering dangerous animals or the magic door failing. Writing this, I feel that my fears are less overwhelming.”

After writing, he lowered the lights and put on soft music, the sound of crickets and the wind through the trees 🎵🌳. He lay down in his little bed and began to do the breathing exercises that the doctor recommended.
With each breath, he felt his body relaxing and his mind quieting 😌. The worries slowly faded away, replaced by a feeling of peace. Before he knew it, he fell sound asleep 😴✨.

The next day, he woke up feeling refreshed and full of energy ☀️😊. The sun was shining through the leaves of the oak tree, and the birds were singing happily 🎶🐦. He decided to visit Dr. Owl to tell her.
Tommy the Tooth Mouse exclaimed excitedly: “Dr. Owl, it worked! I slept all night and I feel great.”
Dr. Owl responded with a smile: “I'm very glad to hear that, Tommy the Tooth Mouse. Did you follow the advice I gave you?”
Tommy the Tooth Mouse said: “Yes, I drank tea, I read, I wrote in my journal, and I did the breathing exercises. They really helped me relax and stop thinking about my adventures and fears.”
Dr. Owl affirmed: “It's wonderful. Remember that it is important to maintain this routine so that your body and mind get used to relaxing before sleep.”
Tommy the Tooth Mouse said: “I will. Thank you for your help.”

From then on, Tommy the Tooth Mouse continued his brave nocturnal adventures 🌃, but he also learned to relax and take care of himself ❤️. Every night, he returned to his home knowing that, with his new routine, he could rest and dream of the stars that shone over the forest ✨🌟.

20.t: The Great Journey of the Panda Family
p: In the wooded mountains of Japan 🏔️🌸, where cherry trees bloom and bamboo grows tall and green, lived a family of pandas 🐼. The father was named Henry, a loving and wise panda who always had advice and a hug for his loved ones. The mother was Alice, strong and brave, known for her determination and courage. Their two little cubs were Yuki and Kevin, curious and playful, always ready for a new adventure. 🐾

Each day, the family explored the magical forest where they lived. The trees whispered ancient songs, and the flowers shone with colors that changed with the sun. Henry taught his children about the stars ⭐ and the legends of the forest, while Alice showed them how to climb the tallest trees and cross the fastest rivers.
One day, while Yuki and Kevin were competing to see who could jump the farthest 🐾🏃‍♂️, they heard a strange sound 👂. It was a loud, constant noise, like distant thunder that wouldn't stop 🌩️.
Yuki asked with wide eyes: "What's that?"
Alice frowned and said with determination: "Let's go find out."
Henry nodded, hugging his cubs to reassure them. "Don't worry, we'll find a solution together," he told them with a calming smile 😊.

The family cautiously advanced until they reached the edge of the forest 🌳, where they saw giant machines they had never seen before 🚧. They were cranes and bulldozers, operated by humans with yellow helmets and orange vests 👷‍♂️.
"They're going to build a road right through here," said the old owl sadly 🦉, who had flown to a nearby branch 🌿. "Our home is in danger." 😔
Alice clenched her fists with determination ✊. "We can't let them destroy our home. We must do something." 💥
"That's right," added Henry gently 🤝. "But we must think wisely and act with love. Maybe we can find a way to make the humans understand." ❤️

The animals of the forest gathered that night in a clearing lit by fireflies 🌟; everyone was worried 😟: the rabbit Cottontail 🐇, the frog Freddie 🐸, even the shy hedgehog Harry 🦔. They talked and talked, but they couldn't find a solution 🤔.
Then, Kevin stepped forward 👣. "What if we talk to the humans? Maybe if we show them how much this forest means to us, they'll change their minds." 💡
The other animals hesitated 😕. "Humans don't understand our language," said Danny the deer with regret 🦌.
But Yuki had an idea 💡. "I know a creature who can help us. The Dream Dragon 🐉🌙 lives on the highest mountain 🗻 and can communicate with any being."
Alice smiled proudly at her son 😊. "That's a brave idea, Yuki. We'll leave at dawn." 🌅

The next day, the Panda family said goodbye to their friends 👋 and began their journey 🚶‍♂️🚶‍♀️. Alice led the way 🛤️, clearing paths and protecting her family from any danger ⚔️. Henry walked beside her, telling stories to keep their spirits high 📖 and offering words of encouragement 👍.

They crossed rushing rivers by jumping on slippery stones 🏞️, climbed hills covered in flowers 🌺, and traversed dense forests where the sun barely filtered through 🌲🌚. Along the way, they helped a family of ducks find their way to the lake 🦆🚣‍♀️ and rescued Mikey, the little monkey 🐒, who had been trapped in a net forgotten by the humans 🕸️.
Finally, after days of travel, they arrived at Sky Mountain ⛰️☁️. It was so high that its peak was lost in the clouds ☁️. Undeterred, they began the ascent 🧗‍♀️.
Alice used her strength to help the little ones climb the steepest parts 💪, while Henry taught them the best routes and pointed out the birds flying above them 🐦.
Upon reaching the summit 🏔️, they found a glowing cave ✨. From it emerged the Dream Dragon 🐉🌙, a majestic creature with scales as bright as the rainbow 🌈 and eyes as deep as the ocean 🌊.
"What do you seek in my dwelling?" 🗣️ she asked with a voice that resonated like music 🎵.

Alice stepped forward, with courage in her gaze 👀. "Our home is in danger. Humans are going to build a road that will destroy the forest. We need your help to communicate with them and save our home." 🙏
The dragon looked at them with tenderness 💖. "I admire your courage and love for your family and home. I will help you. Climb onto my back; we will travel in their dreams." ✨

Confused but trusting her 🤔❤️, the family settled among her shimmering scales 🌟. The dragon took flight 🐉✨, and in the blink of an eye, they were flying over the forest 🌲🌌. The stars seemed close ⭐, and the lights of the cities flickered in the distance 🌃.
They descended gently to the humans' camp 🏕️. The dragon exhaled a soft breath 😌, and the humans fell into a deep sleep 😴.
"Now it's your turn," said the dragon 🐉. "Enter their dreams and show them the beauty of the forest." 🌳✨

And so they did. Henry, with his wisdom and affection 🤗, appeared in the dreams of the engineers and workers 👷‍♂️, leading them by the hand along paths lit by fireflies 🐞, showing them the ancient trees 🌲, the crystal-clear rivers 💧, and the creatures that lived there 🐾. He told them ancient stories about the connection between all living beings 🌐.

Alice, with her strength and bravery 💪, showed them how the forest withstood the storms ⛈️ and how each creature fought to survive 🐾. She taught them the value of perseverance and the importance of protecting what is valuable 💎.

Yuki and Kevin taught them to play among the bamboo 🎋 and to listen to the melodies of the wind 🌬️. The humans marveled at what they saw and felt 😲. They understood that the forest was not just a place but a living being full of magic and life ✨.
At dawn 🌅, the dragon returned the family to the forest 🐉🌳. "I have done what I could. Now, let us wait." 🙏
The following days were uncertain ⏳. The machines were still there 🚧, but the humans seemed different 🤔. They spoke among themselves with concern and pointed to maps and plans 🗺️.

Finally, one morning, the machines stopped 🛑. The humans began to dismantle the camp 🎉. One of them, the chief engineer 👷‍♂️, approached the edge of the forest and said aloud: "This place is too special to destroy. We will look for another route for the road." 🛣️❌
The animals celebrated with joy 🎊. The forest was safe 🌳❤️.
The Panda family thanked the Dream Dragon 🐉🙏, and since then, every night, a glow could be seen in the sky ✨, as a reminder that, with love ❤️, courage 💪, and wisdom 🧠, everything is possible 🌟.
And so, the forest continued to be a magical place ✨, where pandas and other animals lived in harmony 🎶, protected by the promise of the humans to respect nature 🌿🌎.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Bruno who lived in a butcher shop in the heart of a small town. He was a German Shepherd with a shiny coat and intelligent eyes, and he was the pet and guardian of Mr. Miller, the butcher. Bruno spent his days watching over the shop, greeting customers with a friendly wag of his tail, and enjoying the smell of fresh meats.

One morning, while resting at the entrance of the butcher shop, Bruno saw a stray kitten timidly peeking out from a nearby alley. It was a small tabby cat with green eyes full of curiosity. Bruno approached slowly so as not to scare him.
—Hi, I'm Bruno. Who are you? —the dog asked in a friendly voice.
—My name is Felix —the kitten replied, a little nervous—. I'm hungry and was looking for something to eat.
Bruno, moved by Felix's situation, decided to help him. He waited for the right moment and, without Mr. Miller noticing, took a small piece of meat and brought it to the kitten.

From that day on, Bruno and Felix became inseparable. Every afternoon, Bruno would sneak out little pieces of meat to share with his new friend. Together they explored the nearby park, played hide-and-seek, and enjoyed long chats under the shade of the trees. 🐕🐈‍⬛
However, Felix had a worry. A dog named Luna, who lived in the park, constantly bothered him. Luna was a tall, slender Greyhound with a somewhat sour personality, especially towards cats.
—Bruno, I don't know what to do about Luna —Felix confessed one afternoon—. Whenever she sees me, she growls and chases me. I can't even walk around peacefully anymore.
Bruno thought for a moment and then proposed:
—I have an idea. We'll try to earn her trust. Tomorrow, we'll bring her some sausages. Maybe if we're nice to her, she'll change her attitude.
The next day, Bruno took some delicious sausages from the butcher shop. Together, they went to the park and looked for Luna. When they found her, Felix hid behind Bruno.
—Hello, Luna —Bruno greeted with a smile—. We brought you something.
Luna looked at them suspiciously, but the appetizing smell of the sausages made her come closer. She accepted the gift and, after tasting them, seemed to relax a bit.
—Thank you —Luna said softly—. No one has ever been this kind to me before.

Over the next few days, Bruno and Felix continued to visit Luna, bringing her small treats and sharing stories. Little by little, Luna stopped bothering Felix and began to enjoy their company. The three of them became good friends. 🎉

But their good fortune wouldn't last long. Mr. Miller began to notice that meat was missing from his shop. Suspecting Bruno, he decided to watch him. One day, he caught the dog taking some chops for his friends.
—Bruno! —exclaimed the butcher, angry—. So it was you! I gave you a home, and this is how you repay me, by stealing!
Without listening to his whimpers, Mr. Miller tied Bruno to a doghouse in the backyard, preventing him from ever entering the butcher shop again. 😢

Bruno felt sad and regretful. Not for helping his friends, but for betraying Mr. Miller's trust. However, his friends did not abandon him. Every day, Felix and Luna would visit him, bringing him news from the park and keeping him company.
—Don't worry, Bruno —Felix would say—. We're here with you.
—We'll find a way to fix things —Luna would add with determination.
The butcher, watching from the window, noticed the loyalty and affection the animals shared. He saw how, despite the circumstances, Bruno remained a faithful and generous friend.

One night, as he was thinking, Mr. Miller remembered how lonely he had felt since his wife had passed away and how Bruno had given him unconditional companionship. He realized that perhaps he had been too harsh.
The next morning, he approached Bruno.
—My friend, I'm sorry —he said, petting his head—. I didn't understand that you only wanted to help those in need. But you have to promise me you'll never steal again.
Bruno nodded, his eyes shining brightly.
—I promise —he seemed to say with his sincere gaze.

Mr. Miller untied Bruno, and together they went into the shop. From that day on, Mr. Miller began to prepare a basket with leftovers and cuts of meat he couldn't sell. Every afternoon, he and Bruno would take them to the park to feed the stray animals. Felix, Luna, and many others benefited from their generosity.

The news spread through the town, and soon more people joined in the kind gesture. The park became a place of gathering and harmony between humans and animals. Mr. Miller found his joy again and understood the value of sharing and being compassionate. 😊
Bruno, Felix, and Luna remained the best of friends. They learned that even though actions can sometimes have difficult consequences, sincerity and kindness always find a way to win.
And so, in that small corner of the world, everyone discovered that friendship and solidarity can transform hearts and unite lives in unimaginable ways. ❤️

Owen lived in a house with a small but charming garden, but for him, only one thing truly mattered: a yellow rose he found one day while exploring a forgotten corner. He didn't know where it had come from, but as soon as he saw it, he knew it was the most beautiful rose he had ever seen. It was so perfect that he decided it would be his. 🌹

From that moment on, the rose became his treasure. He spent hours watching it, imagining how he would care for it to keep it beautiful forever. His grandfather had taught him how to care for plants, but Owen was convinced he could do something more, something special to make the rose shine even brighter than any other flower in the garden.
—It just needs more water and fewer ugly leaves, he thought, looking at the small spots on some of the leaves.💧

With that thought, he began to water the rose more often, and every time he saw a leaf that didn't look perfect, he snipped it off without a second thought. He believed he was helping, that his constant attention would make the rose even more impressive. However, over time, the rose began to lose its glow. What were once bright petals and green leaves started to wither.😢

Owen didn't understand what was happening. How was this possible? He watered it every day, caring for it so meticulously. He was sure he was doing the right thing. But one morning, when he went out to the garden, he found his rose completely withered. The yellow petals he loved so much were scattered on the ground, and the stem could barely stand up.

Owen's world fell apart. How had it come to this? He sat down next to the rose, looking at the fallen petals around him, and felt something inside him break. He had wanted that rose so much, he had wanted it for himself… How could he have lost it?

—Maybe I did too much, he whispered, his eyes filling with tears. What if I hadn't watered it so much? What if I hadn't cut off so many leaves? The questions began to fill his mind, growing heavier and heavier.

Suddenly, everything around him faded away. The garden disappeared, and Owen found himself in a dark place, covered in a thick fog. He walked without knowing where he was going, and in the distance, he heard a voice whispering: You could have saved it...

The voice followed him, echoing in his head, and the more he walked, the louder it became. You didn't care for it properly... Owen tried to ignore it, but he couldn't escape. Soon, he ran into a monster made of shadows, its eyes glowing with a dark light.
—I am the Monster of Guilt —said the creature in a deep voice—. I've come to remind you of what you lost. That rose depended on you, but you let it wither.🥀

Owen tried to answer, but the words wouldn't come out. He knew the monster was right. He wanted to run, to get away from the guilt that tormented him, but the monster stayed close, whispering everything he had done wrong in his ear.
—It's not fair! —he finally shouted—. I just wanted it to be perfect... to be mine.

The shadows wrapped around him, and Owen felt trapped in his own mind. But just when he thought he couldn't escape, he saw a faint light in the distance. It was small, but it was enough to give him a little hope. ✨

He ran toward the light, as the monster yelled after him: You can't run from me. But Owen, determined to escape, didn't stop running until he reached the source of the light. There, he found a wise old woman sitting under a gigantic tree.
—Why are you running, little one? —the old woman asked with a calm smile.
—I lost my rose —Owen answered, still out of breath—. I found it one day, I took such good care of it, but now it's withered and I can't stand the guilt.
—Sometimes, too much love and care can do more harm than good, Owen. Things, just like roses, need their own space to bloom. You can't force them to be perfect.
—But I wanted it for myself —Owen replied—. It was the most beautiful rose I had ever seen, and I wanted it just for me.

—And that is the problem, my child —said the old woman—. The rose was never yours, nor did it belong to anyone before you. You simply found it. Roses, like all living things, belong to themselves. You were just its temporary caretaker.
Owen looked down, finally understanding what he had done. In his desire to make it perfect and claim it as his own, he had suffocated it. He had wanted too much.
—But now it's gone —he said, staring at the ground.
—Not all is lost —the old woman answered—. Sometimes, from what seems like an end, a new opportunity arises.
The old woman handed him a tiny seed, shiny and full of life. 🌱
—From what is left of your rose, new life can sprout —she said—. The seeds of hope are always there, even if we can't see them.
Owen woke up from that strange dream, back in his garden. He walked slowly to what was left of the withered rose and, to his surprise, he saw tiny seeds around the dry stem.

The rose wasn't mine, he thought, remembering the old woman's words. And although he couldn't go back in time, he knew there was something new he could care for. He carefully gathered the seeds and planted them in a corner of the garden.
As he covered them with soil, Grandpa Miller walked over and placed a hand on his shoulder.
—Are you okay, Owen? —he asked in a gentle voice.
Owen smiled slightly and nodded.
—I'll take better care of them this time, Grandpa —he said, looking at the seeds he had just planted.
—Oh, Owen Miller... —his grandfather sighed, resting a warm, wrinkled hand on the little boy's shoulder—. Well, I suppose you've learned a thing or two about roses.
And so, Owen learned that life doesn't always give second chances, but that sometimes, when one rose withers, it leaves behind seeds that nourish hope. 🌸✨

23.t: The Pufferfish Who Was Afraid to Puff Up
p: Once upon a time, in the deep blue ocean, lived a little pufferfish named Glupi. Glupi was a very special fish because, like all pufferfish, he could puff up like a ball when he got scared. But Glupi had a problem! He was very afraid of puffing up.

One day, while swimming through the coral reefs, Glupi met his friend, Tina the turtle. Tina was always calm and never seemed to worry about anything. “Hello, Glupi,” said Tina in her soft voice. “Why do you have such a sad face?”
Glupi sighed. “It’s just… I’m afraid to puff up. What if I don’t know how to do it right? What if I puff up and never go back down?”
Tina giggled a little, but not in a mean way. “Oh, Glupi! It’s okay, puffing up is natural for you. Why don’t you try it now? I’m here with you.”
Glupi shook his head. “No, no, Tina. I’m embarrassed! What if someone sees me? Everyone will think I’m weird.”

Suddenly, they heard a loud “BOOM!”. It was Lolo, the mischievous octopus, who had thrown a giant rock to the bottom of the sea. “Hello, friends! What are you doing here?” asked Lolo, waving his tentacles.
Tina explained: “Glupi is afraid to puff up.”

Lolo let out a big laugh, but then he realized that Glupi was very worried. "Hey, Glupi, it's okay to be scared. All the animals in the ocean are afraid of something. Look, I sometimes hide under the rocks when I see a shark. And no one laughs at me for that!”
Glupi asked, surprised: “Really?”

Lolo nodded. “Of course! Being afraid is normal. But when you face it, you realize it’s not so bad,” said Lolo, twirling his tentacles. “Besides, if you puff up and feel weird, you just deflate and that’s it! You don’t have to stay like that forever.”
Glupi thought for a moment. “Well… maybe I could try it, just a little bit.”

Tina and Lolo looked at him with encouraging smiles. Glupi took a deep breath, closed his eyes, and PUM!, he puffed up like a big yellow balloon. When he opened his eyes, he saw that his friends were looking at him with pride.
“You did it!” said Tina excitedly.
Glupi realized it wasn’t so bad. “Hey, it’s not so horrible! It’s fun!” he shouted, and he started rolling around on the seabed like a giant ball. Tina and Lolo couldn’t stop laughing.
Finally, Glupi deflated little by little and returned to his normal size. “Thank you, friends. I don’t think I’m so afraid of puffing up anymore. It’s easier when you know you’re not alone!”
And so, Glupi learned that sometimes what scares us the most isn’t so bad when we try it. And it’s always better with friends! 😊
The End. 🐠🌊

24.t: The Summer Storm and the Secret of Petrichor
p: It was a sweltering summer afternoon, and Lily was sitting on the patio of her house with her father. The first gray clouds began to cover the sky, and a light breeze started to blow. The air filled with that fresh scent that only appears before the rain falls. Lily was always excited to see summer storms, those that came with thunder and a wind that cooled the air. 🌩️
— Dad, it looks like it's going to rain, she said, watching the clouds swirl overhead.
Her father smiled and stroked her hair.
— Yes, I see, he replied. — It's one of those summer storms, the kind you enjoy.

Little by little, the first drops began to fall. A soft drop slid down Lily's cheek, while others fell on the leaves of the nearby trees. The sound of the rain was like a soft melody, and the world around seemed to stop, as if everyone was listening attentively. 🌧️
Lily looked at her father, who was breathing deeply and closing his eyes for a moment, enjoying the fresh air.
— Dad, it smells different when it rains, doesn't it? she asked curiously.
Her father opened his eyes and smiled.
— What you're smelling is called petrichor, he explained. — It's the aroma that comes from the earth when it starts to rain, especially after many days of heat and drought.
Lily frowned.
— Petrichor? she repeated, tasting the word in her mouth. — And why does it smell so good?
Her father got up and arranged the chairs under the awning, side by side so they could sit facing the storm, and prepared to tell her the secret.

— Petrichor is a mixture of oils that plants release during dry days and bacteria that live in the soil. When it rains, the raindrops release those oils and bacteria, and that's what produces that pleasant smell.
Lily, leaning on her father's arm, took a deep breath, trying to capture every note of the fresh aroma that surrounded her.
— It's like the earth is taking a shower and then smells clean, she said, smiling. Her father nodded, happy that she understood. 😊

As the storm continued, the two remained silent, listening to the soft drumming of the rain on the roof. The thunder could be heard in the distance, like drums celebrating life, the echo of a conversation that nature was having with itself. ⚡
— I really like petrichor, Lily said after a while. — It's like the smell of a secret that we can only discover when it rains.
Her father looked at her tenderly and, putting his arm around her shoulders, kissed her forehead.
— Exactly, Lily. It's one of those little treasures that nature gives us, if we know how to feel it and enjoy it. 🌈
The rain gradually subsided, and the sky began to clear. On the horizon, a rainbow began to form, painting the sky with bright colors.
— Look, a rainbow! Lily said excitedly, pointing to it.
— It's like the storm left us another gift, her father commented, smiling.
And so, with the sound of the last drops falling gently, Lily and her father stayed on the patio for a while longer, enjoying the petrichor, the calm of the storm, and the shared moment. ☔

25.t: Glupi, Tina, and the Magic Marble
p: Deep in the sea, on a sunny day, Glupi and Tina were swimming peacefully among the corals. Suddenly, something shiny caught their eyes. Among the seaweed, they found a small, round, colorful ball. It was a human marble that sparkled with all the colors of the rainbow when the sunlight hit it.
“Wow, look at that!” exclaimed Glupi. “It's a magic marble! I want it for myself!” 😮
Tina frowned. “No, Glupi. I found it too. It's mine!” 😤
The two friends looked at each other defiantly. Glupi puffed out his cheeks, but not like when he was scared—he was angry! Tina, who was usually calm, also began to lose her patience.
“I saw it first!” shouted Glupi 😠.
“But I want it more!” replied Tina, crossing her fins 😡.
The atmosphere, which had been cheerful, became tense. The two friends turned away from each other, back to back, not knowing what to do. Neither wanted to give in.
Suddenly, while they were still angry, Lolo the octopus appeared. “What's going on here?” he asked, moving his tentacles curiously 🐙.
“We found this magic marble, but Tina won't let me have it,” explained Glupi, puffed up with rage 😡.
“That's not true! Glupi doesn't want to share it with me,” added Tina 😔.
Lolo looked at them both and then observed the marble. “Wow, it's very pretty! But, you know what? Arguing isn't going to make the marble any more magical. Why don't you try sharing it?”
Tina and Glupi looked at him, confused. “Share it? How can you share a marble?” asked Glupi 🤔.

Lolo smiled and began to explain. “You can take turns playing with it. One day you have it, another day Tina has it. Or even, you can play together with it. Sometimes, the most magical thing about something is being able to enjoy it with a friend.”
Tina and Glupi were quiet, thinking about what Lolo had said. Looking at each other, they both felt a little sad for having argued.
“I'm sorry, Glupi,” said Tina, looking down. “I didn't want us to fight over this. We can share it.”
“I'm sorry too, Tina,” replied Glupi, slowly deflating. “You're right. It's more fun if we both use it.”
Lolo laughed. “That's better! Now, why don't we have a marble race? I can make the course with my tentacles.” 🐙🎉

And that's how Tina and Glupi learned that sharing is much more fun than arguing. They played together with the marble all day, laughing and enjoying themselves, and in the end, the marble wasn't the most magical thing… the most magical thing was their friendship 😊💫.
Once upon a time, there was a little cloud that floated gently in the blue sky. It was made of soft cotton, so soft it looked like a fluffy pillow. ☁️

One day, the little cloud decided to go on a long stroll. It drifted its fluffy body between the mountains and down toward a field of flowers. There, among the butterflies fluttering by, the bees buzzed busily, and the air smelled like lavender and honey. Everything was so peaceful, and the cloud felt happy, ready to continue its journey. 🌸🐝

It kept floating until it reached a very big lake. The water was so clear you could see the sun shining on it, just like a sparkly mirror. The cloud decided to float a little lower, until it touched the water with its tummy. The lake felt cool and fresh, and the cloud felt a happy tickle as it gathered up shiny little drops of water. 💧
It stayed to play for a little while, when something caught its eye: some little ducklings were swimming and splashing behind their mommy, who was teaching them how to find snacks.
“How peaceful!” —the cloud thought.
It watched the ducklings bob up and down on the water, just like it bobbed in the sky. 🦆

After a little while, the cloud decided to continue its journey. It floated over to a forest full of very tall trees. The trees whispered in the gentle breeze, and birds sang quiet songs. It decided to rest a bit more, floating between the branches, enjoying the wind and the birds’ singing. It let the leaves brush gently against its fluffy body, leaving behind some of the shiny drops it had picked up from the lake. 🌳🐦

When the sun began to hide behind the mountains, the cloud knew it was time to go home. So it floated slowly up, up, up into the sky, watching the day say goodbye with pretty pink, orange, and purple colors. Everything was calm. 🌅
The cloud, happy and relaxed, snuggled up between the stars and closed its eyes.
“This was a wonderful day,” it thought, as it drifted in the gently rocking night sky. ⭐️🌙
And so, the cotton cloud fell asleep, floating softly, while the world below was quiet and peaceful. 😴

27.t: Glupi, Tina, and the First Day of School
p: The big day had arrived: Glupi, Tina, and Lolo were going to start school! They were all very excited, but there was one small detail that made them a little sad… Lolo, the octopus, wasn’t going to the same school as his friends. He had been assigned to another one, closer to the cave where he lived.
“We’re going to have a great time for sure,” said Glupi, puffed up with excitement. “We’re going to meet new friends, Tina!”
“Yes, but… I’m worried about Lolo,” said Tina with a sad frown. “He’s going to a different school. What if he doesn’t have a good time?”
“Lolo is brave!” said Glupi, trying to cheer her up. “He’ll surely make lots of friends.”

The first day arrived, and just as they thought, Glupi and Tina had a fantastic time. They played with other fish, learned about magic seaweed, and even met a super friendly crab named Crispin. But at the end of the day, when they met up with Lolo, they saw he was very different. He was quiet, his tentacles barely moved, and his eyes were a little red.
“What’s wrong, Lolo?” asked Tina with concern.
Lolo sighed. “I didn’t like my school. I feel alone. Everyone has their friends, and I don’t know anyone. I ended up crying in class…”
Glupi and Tina looked at each other with heavy hearts. They had had such a good time, and now Lolo was sad. “Don’t worry, Lolo. Tomorrow will be better for sure,” said Glupi, trying to smile.

But the days passed, and Lolo remained sad. Glupi and Tina told him stories about their school, but that only made Lolo feel worse. “It’s not fair,” Lolo murmured. “You’re together, and I… I’m alone.”

However, one day, something changed. When Glupi and Tina arrived at their usual meeting place at the end of classes, they saw Lolo swimming happily. And he wasn’t alone—he had a new friend! It was a starfish named Estelito. He had a huge smile, and his five arms shone with the colors of coral.
“Hi, guys!” shouted Lolo, his tentacles moving fast with excitement. “I want you to meet my new friend, Estelito. We had a great time today!”
Glupi and Tina smiled, seeing how happy their friend was. “Nice to meet you, Estelito!” said Tina. “I’m so glad that Lolo has a friend as fun as you!”

Lolo explained everything that had happened at his new school: how at first it was hard for him, but little by little he started talking to the other students, and one day he met Estelito, who was also looking for friends. “We get along great! We race through the seaweed and play hide-and-seek under the rocks!”
Glupi puffed up his belly with joy. “See, Lolo? We knew you could do it. Sometimes, you just need a little patience.”
Tina nodded. “The important thing is that you didn’t give up. And now you have a new friend. And it doesn’t matter if we’re in different schools—we’ll always be friends!”
Lolo smiled, relieved. “Thanks, guys. You’re right! Now I know that no matter where we are, I can always make new friends. And I have you too!”
And so, Lolo, Glupi, Tina, and Estelito remained great friends, proving that even though things change, friendship always finds its way.

28.t: Far Horizons 1: The Voyage to Veridia-7
p: Aura watched from her bedroom window, her heart heavy. The sun was slowly hiding behind the city's tall buildings, painting the sky in shades of orange and purple, but her mind was filled with darkness. This sunset would be the last she'd see from her home on Earth. Tomorrow, she and her mother would depart for the first stop of a journey millions of light-years away.

There had been much talk about Veridia-7, the planet that scientists assured would be humanity's new home. The reports were encouraging: breathable air, abundant water, and flora that could become the basis of their diet. But all of that didn't matter to Aura now. What she really felt was a mixture of sadness and fear. 😟

—Everything is going to be alright, you know? —Mara's voice echoed from the doorway. Mara, one of the world's leading biomechanical engineers, was always sure of everything. She had helped develop the physical enhancements that would allow them to better adapt to the new planet. However, at that moment, she didn't seem so firm. Nim, her hybrid pet, rested in her arms, purring softly as its scaly tail curled around her hands.

Aura slowly turned her head and looked at her, swallowing the words that wanted to escape. “What if I don't want to go? What if I don't think I can leave my friends behind?” But she knew that wasn't an option. She had been prepared for this since she could remember. Traveling to space, being part of the first human colony on a new planet... it was her destiny, even if she hadn't chosen it.
—Nim is sad too, isn't he? —Aura asked, stroking the head of the little being that shared feline and lizard-like features, a combination that, despite everything, brought her comfort. 🐱🦎

—Nim will be fine, just like us —Mara replied with a warm smile—. This is the beginning of something big, Aura. We're going to be part of history. Besides, I know you'll make new friends, you always do.

But Aura wasn't so convinced. As they packed their bags to leave their home for the last time, she couldn't stop thinking about what she was leaving behind: her friendships, her school, and Earth, the only place she had ever known. The space base, where they would spend their last days on the planet, would be full of other colonists, all excited and nervous, but she would feel lonelier than ever. 😔

When they finally arrived at the base, the majesty of the ships took their breath away. Those enormous metal structures would be launched into space and would be their home for the next three years, as they prepared to descend on Veridia-7. There was no turning back.
—Mom, what if something goes wrong? —Aura asked, feeling that she could finally express the fear she had been trying to hide.
Mara knelt beside her, looking directly into her eyes.
—We are more prepared than ever. We're not going alone, Aura. And you, with your talent and abilities, will be key in this mission, you know that, right?

Aura nodded, but wasn't sure she believed it. She just wanted everything to be as it was before, but knew that the future left them no choice but to move forward. With a sigh, she followed her mother towards the ship, while Nim jumped onto her shoulder, wrapping its tail around her arm. Although she was sad and scared, a small part of her was beginning to feel a spark of curiosity about what awaited them out there.

Aura spent the next three days receiving training on how to manage the improvements implanted in her body. Using a holographic screen that occupied the entire center of the room they had been assigned, she worked on controlling her new abilities. Her mother was out practically all day; they only got together at dinner time. Mara, as one of the highest-ranking officers, had many details to prepare before departure.

Finally, the day arrived. They headed to the shuttles that would be their home for the next three years. The ascent reminded her of the last time she went to the amusement park with her friends 🎢, and she felt a pang of deep nostalgia for what she was leaving behind, which made her shed a few silent tears.

The interior of the ship was immense and bright, with long curved corridors and metal walls that reflected the blue lights. In the common room, several boys and girls of her age were already gathering in small circles, some with their pets too. Voices echoed through the space, full of excitement, but Aura didn't feel ready to join. Her mother left her in her compartment and went to the officers' lounge, where she had to work on the ship's preparations and coordinate the hibernation systems that would be key to the journey.
When Aura dared to go out, she approached one of the leisure rooms and sat away from the people, marveling at all the details of the ship.
—Hi, can I sit here? —a girl asked, interrupting Aura's thoughts. She had short hair and bright green eyes. Aura nodded slowly.
—My name is Zoe, and you?
—Aura —she replied, trying to smile.
Zoe didn't seem scared or sad. On the contrary, she spoke enthusiastically about how exciting it was to leave Earth and start a new life on a different planet.
—Veridia-7 will be incredible. Did you know that it has moons that never set? There will always be light somewhere. And they say the water is so crystal clear that you can see miles through it.

Aura was surprised by the passion with which Zoe spoke of the new home. Maybe, she thought, it wouldn't be so bad after all. At least she had made a first contact. Zoe continued talking about the wonders of Veridia-7, how her family had big plans to establish a new communications network on the planet and how important that work would be.

The days on the ship passed slowly at first. Aura began to get more involved in group activities, and gradually formed a small group of friends. Zoe, who had become her closest friend, always had a new story to tell about Veridia-7 or about the projects her parents were working on.

One day, while they were practicing in the low-gravity simulator, the ship experienced a strong jolt. The floor tilted suddenly and the lights flickered before going out completely. For a few seconds, the silence was absolute, until the alarms started to sound.
“Code red!” —the voice of one of the pilots was heard through the speakers—. “Please, all units, prepare for an emergency.”

Aura felt her heart race. She knew something like this could happen, but she wasn't prepared for the fear that invaded her at that moment. Zoe grabbed her hand, and together they ran towards the safety pods.

The problem seemed to be in one of the ship's navigation systems, which had failed and diverted its course towards an asteroid field. The situation was complicated, as the ship's shields could not be activated at that time. The engineers worked frantically to fix it, but time was running out.

Aura remembered the lessons she had received on how to react in emergency situations, but being in the middle of one was completely different. The children were taken to a security room while the adults tried to manage the situation. She knew that her mother would most likely have had to go outside, and she was really scared of not seeing her again.
After several hours of tension, the announcement that everyone was waiting for was heard.
“Problem solved. The ship has resumed its course. Please continue with your activities normally.”

Although everything had returned to normal, something had changed in Aura. That experience had made her aware that, no matter how much they prepared, there would always be unforeseen events. And the important thing was not to avoid them, but to know how to face them.

The ship had become her new home, and her new friends her new family. Aura had gained more confidence and had realized the value of her mother. She was willing to work hard to live up to her. They were a group of people chosen for a great adventure. Together, they were preparing for the greatest challenge of all: conquering Veridia-7. 🚀🌍

29.t: The Secret of the Golden Beach
p: In a small coastal town, surrounded by high cliffs, there was a hidden cove that lit up every afternoon with a soft, golden light. It seemed like a magical place: the sand, soft and silky like stardust, sparkled under the sun, and the waves, calmed by the rocks protecting the entrance, arrived at the shore with a whisper that tickled your ears.

Leo and his sister Mia lived in the last house in town, right next to the path that led down to the golden beach. Every day, after finishing their chores, they loved to walk there. As they strolled along the shore, the warm sand trickled between their toes, and a gentle breeze caressed their faces, as if the beach itself was inviting them to relax. 🌊
—Can you imagine if we found a treasure? —asked Leo, picking up seashells from the shore.
Mia smiled. 😄
—Maybe the treasure isn't something we can keep —she said—, but something we can feel.

Intrigued by his sister's words, Leo continued walking in silence. That day, the tide was lower than usual, allowing them to reach a rocky area where the seawater was so still it looked like a mirror. They sat on the sand, watching the sun slowly set, painting the sky in shades of orange and pink. 🌅

Above them, seagulls sang softly, and the constant murmur of the waves created a peaceful melody, making everything around them feel calm. Leo suddenly understood: this was the magic of the golden beach, a place where peace seemed to wrap around everything, as if the whole world was in harmony.
—This is our treasure —whispered Mia, closing her eyes and taking a deep breath. 🌸
Leo copied her, feeling how each wave seemed to rock them in a gentle, calming hug.

They let time pass without rushing, just listening to the serene rhythm of the sea, feeling the warm sand beneath their skin, and enjoying the playful breeze that ruffled their hair. Every breath was filled with the salty scent of the ocean, and slowly, the sun gave way to a sky full of stars that began to twinkle shyly above them. 🌟

When the moon gently lit up the beach with its silvery light, Leo and Mia looked at each other and smiled. They knew that even when they went home, they could always return to this place, not just with their feet, but also in their memories, whenever they needed to feel calm.
—The treasure has always been here —Leo said softly as they stood up to leave. 🌙

With the sound of the waves walking with them, the two siblings headed back along the golden beach, knowing they had discovered the most valuable secret of all: the peace the sea gives you when you listen with your heart. 💖

30.t: The Search for the Magic Feather
p: It was a quiet morning in the valley where Grit and Grat lived. The twins, always restless, were playing near their cave when they overheard their mother, Groka, talking to their father, Gruk.
—It would be wonderful to get a giant bird feather for the tribe's cloak. It would protect us during the winter, —said Groka, as she patiently weaved.
Grit and Grat, always attentive to any opportunity for adventure, looked at each other with bright eyes.
—Mom needs a giant bird feather! We must find one! —said Grit, already thinking about how she could fulfill this mission.
Grat, more thoughtful, replied:
—Yes, but giant birds are not easy to find. And we can't get close to them either… They are dangerous.
—That doesn't mean we can't look for a feather that has fallen. Surely, if we investigate, we will find one, —replied Grit, determined.

The twins knew that a cloak made with feathers from a giant bird, even if it didn't have magical properties, would be a symbol of prestige and would protect their family from the harsh winter winds. 🦅
So, without wasting time, Grit and Grat took their backpacks and began to explore the valley, where it was known that large prehistoric birds sometimes nested in the nearby mountains.
—If we find a feather, Mom and Dad will be so proud of us, —said Grit as they walked. Grat, although a little doubtful, also felt excited about the idea.

For hours, the twins searched everywhere: in the forest clearings, in the valleys, and near the rivers. There was no trace of giant bird feathers. As the day progressed, Grit began to feel frustrated.
—Maybe we should give up, Grit. It doesn't seem like we are going to find anything, —said Grat, exhausted.
But Grit didn't want to give up.
—No, Grat! I'm sure that if we keep looking a little longer, we will succeed.
Finally, as the sun began to set, Grat saw something shining among the bushes.
—Grit, come quickly! —she shouted. Upon approaching, they found an enormous feather, as big as Gruk's arm.
—We found it! —they exclaimed excitedly.
The feather, although dirty and a little broken by the wind, was just what they needed. Without thinking twice, the twins picked it up very carefully. 🪶
Back in the cave, Grit and Grat showed the feather to their parents. Groka, with a satisfied smile, said:
—You have done an incredible job, girls! This feather will be perfect for the cloak that will protect our family.

Grit and Grat, exhausted but happy, felt very proud to have persevered despite the difficulties. They had learned that, sometimes, the greatest achievements do not come easily, but with effort and determination, anything is possible. 💪
And that's all folks! 🎉

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tommy who was three years old and lived in a house full of love with his mommy and daddy. Tommy loved to play with his toys, paint with bright colors, and listen to stories before bed. 🎨📚
One day, his parents told him they had some very special news. 💌
—Tommy, soon there will be someone else in our family, —said his mom with a smile. 😊
—Is Grandma coming to visit? —asked Tommy excitedly. 👵❤️
—Not exactly, —replied his dad. —You're going to have a little brother or sister. 👶
Tommy thought for a moment. He wasn't sure what it meant to have a little sibling. That night, in his bed, he hugged his favorite stuffed animal, Hoppy the bunny, tightly and whispered: 💤🐇
—Hoppy, what's a little brother?
The next day, at the park, Tommy saw his friend Lily playing with her little brother. 🛝
—Hi, Lily, —greeted Tommy. —What's it like having a brother?
—It's fun, —replied Lily. —We play together and tell each other secrets. 🤫
Tommy wasn't convinced yet. He had many questions in his head. Will my parents still love me the same? Will I have to share my toys? 🤔
That night, during the bedtime story, Tommy said to his mom:
—Mom, I'm a little scared of having a little sibling.
His mom looked at him tenderly and replied: ❤️
—It's normal to feel a little scared, sweetie. But you know what? Our love doesn't divide; it multiplies! We'll have more love to give.
—What if the baby plays with my toys? —asked Tommy worriedly.
—You can share some toys, but you'll also have your special things just for you, —assured his dad. —Plus, you can teach them how to play, and you'll be their hero.
The months passed, and the awaited day arrived. Tommy's little sister, named Lucy, was born. When Tommy saw her for the first time, she was as small and soft as a stuffed animal. 👶💖
—Hi, Lucy, —he whispered. —I'm your big brother.
Lucy opened her little eyes and seemed to smile. At that moment, Tommy felt something warm in his heart. ❤️
However, after a few days, Tommy realized that Lucy couldn't play with him as he had imagined. She slept a lot and cried often. 😴😭
—Mom, Lucy is a bit boring, —said Tommy with a sigh. —She can't play with me or run.
His mom smiled and explained:
—I know, sweetie. Lucy is still very small. She needs time to grow and learn. But in the meantime, you can help her and take care of her.
—How long will it take for her to grow? —asked Tommy impatiently.
—She'll grow a little more each day, —replied his dad. —And before you know it, you'll be able to play together.

One day, while Lucy was quietly in her crib, Tommy felt such a great love for her that he decided to give her a hug. 🤗 He approached and, without realizing his own strength, squeezed her little arms with enthusiasm. Lucy began to cry uncontrollably. 😢
Alarmed, his parents rushed over.
—What happened, Tommy? —asked his dad.
—I just wanted to hug her because I love her very much, —said Tommy with tear-filled eyes. —I didn't want to make her cry.
His mom hugged him and said gently:
—I understand you want to show her your love, but Lucy is very fragile. We must be very gentle with her.
—How can I show her I love her without hurting her? —asked Tommy.
—You can gently stroke her hand, sing her a song, or just be by her side, —suggested his dad. —Would you like to try?
Tommy nodded. He approached Lucy and, very carefully, stroked her cheek. Lucy stopped crying and looked at her brother with curiosity. 👶❤️
—Look, she's not crying anymore! —exclaimed Tommy excitedly.
—See? —said his mom. —Sometimes, the smallest gestures show the greatest love.
From then on, Tommy learned to manage his intense emotions and express his affection in gentler ways. He sang songs to Lucy when she was awake and calm, strengthening their special bond. 🎵👫
Over time, Tommy discovered that Lucy did something new every day. One day she started smiling at him, another day she tried to babble funny sounds. 😊🍼
One night, Tommy snuggled in bed with his mom, his dad, and little Lucy. He looked at his family and smiled. 🌙💤
—I think having a little sister is the big secret to happiness, —he said before closing his eyes and sleeping peacefully.
And so, Tommy discovered that love grows and that there is room in the heart for everyone. The End. ❤️✨

32.t: Lolo's Birthday at the Amusement Park
p: It was a very special day at the bottom of the sea 🌊: it was the birthday of Lolo the octopus 🐙! He had invited his best friends: Glupi the pufferfish 🐡, Tina the turtle 🐢, Estelito the starfish ⭐, and Crispín the crab 🦀, to celebrate at the underwater amusement park 🎢.

The park had lots of fun rides: the Coral Coaster 🎢, which went up and down very fast through the corals; the Marine Tornado 🌪️, which spun round and round until it made anyone dizzy; and the Seahorse Carousel 🎠, which was calm and full of colorful lights 🌈.
—Welcome to the park! —said Lolo excitedly—. How about we start with the Coral Coaster? 🎢
—Yes, let's go! —exclaimed Glupi and Estelito, jumping for joy.
Tina smiled, but inside she was nervous. —Um... I think I need to go to the restroom 🚽. You guys go ahead, I'll catch up.
—Are you sure? We can wait —offered Crispín.
—No, no, you go 😊. I won't be long! —replied Tina, swimming quickly towards the restroom.
While her friends rode the Coral Coaster, Tina watched them from below. She was scared of fast rides 😰, but she didn't want her friends to know. When they got off, everyone was so happy 😄.
—That was amazing! —said Lolo—. Should we go on the Marine Tornado now? 🌪️
—Yes! —shouted Glupi and Estelito.
Tina felt nervous again 😟. —Oh, I think... um... I need to... check on my shell 🐚. You all go on the Marine Tornado.
Glupi looked at her curiously 🤔. —Tina, are you okay? You seem a little worried.
—Yes, yes, I'm fine —said Tina, trying to smile 😊.
While her friends enjoyed the Marine Tornado, Tina sat on a coral bench 🪸, feeling a little sad 😔. She didn't want to keep making up excuses, but she was afraid to tell the truth.
When they came back, Crispín went over to her and said gently, —Tina, we noticed you don't want to get on the rides. Is something wrong?
Tina sighed and lowered her head 😞. —The truth is, I'm scared of fast rides. I didn't want to tell you and spoil the fun.
Lolo put a tentacle on her shoulder and smiled 😊. —Don't worry, Tina! You don't have to do anything you don't like.
—Yeah, we can do things that make you feel comfortable —added Estelito 🌟.
—Really? —asked Tina, feeling relieved 😌.
—Of course! —said Glupi—. How about we go on the Seahorse Carousel? 🎠 It's calmer and very pretty.
—I would love that! —exclaimed Tina with a big smile 😀.
They all got on the carousel, enjoying the gentle motion and the bright lights ✨. Tina laughed happily with her friends, feeling like part of the group ❤️.
Afterward, they found a ride called the Seaweed Seesaw 🌿, which was fun but not too fast. —Do you want to try this one, Tina? —asked Crispín.
Tina looked at the ride and, although she was a little scared 😬, she decided to try it. —Yes, let's go!
They all got on together and enjoyed the Seaweed Seesaw. Tina realized that with her friends by her side, she could try new things and have fun 🎉.
At the end of the day, Lolo organized a starfish fishing game ⭐ (toy ones, of course), and everyone won prizes 🏅. Tina won a beautiful shell that sounded like a little bell when she shook it 🔔.
—Thank you for understanding and for being such good friends —said Tina, touched 😊.
—That's what friends are for! —replied Lolo—. The important thing is that we're together and that we all have a good time.
—And remember, Tina —added Glupi—, you don't have to do anything that scares you. We have more fun when everyone is happy.
—Yes! —they all said in unison 🤗.

And so, Lolo's birthday was a special day for everyone, full of laughter 😂, games 🎲, and most of all, a lot of friendship 🤝. Tina went home happy, knowing she had friends who loved her just the way she was ❤️.

33.t: Danny and the Mystery of Love
p: Once upon a time, there was a little detective named Danny, who always carried a magnifying glass and a funny hat. One day, Danny wondered, "What is love?" It was such a big mystery that he decided to go out and solve it. 🕵️‍♂️💖
First, Danny walked to a house where he saw a mom giving her son a very warm hug. "Hmm, this seems important," Danny thought. He went closer and asked—
"What is love to you?"
The mom replied—
"Love is respect and care," as she hugged her son.
Danny took out his notebook and wrote down the first clue: "Love is respect, it's a warm hug..."
He kept walking and arrived at a park where two friends were laughing and playing together, tossing a ball back and forth. Danny walked over, curious, and asked—
"What is love to you?"
The friends answered—
"Love is laughing and sharing."
Danny, happy with the answer, added to his notebook: "Love is also laughter, it's playing and building..."

Later, Danny passed by a town square where a grandma was teaching her grandson how to ride a bike. The boy would fall, but his grandma was always there to help him get back up. Danny watched and then asked them—
"What is love to you?"
The grandma replied with a smile—
"Love is being there, near or far, always helping."
Danny, with a big smile, wrote: "Love is an 'I love you' that fills your heart, it's being close by or far away, giving support and protection..."

But the mystery wasn't completely solved yet, so Danny continued on his way. He came to a small river, where a family was working together to pick flowers and make a beautiful bouquet. The detective went closer and asked—
"What is love to you?"
The family answered—
"Love is sticking together, no matter what happens."
Danny jotted down the next clue: "It's staying united, even when things are hard, because love grows stronger in the face of adversity..."

Finally, Danny sat on a bench, thinking about everything he had learned that day. He took out his notebook and carefully reviewed all his notes. And there, between the lines, he found the complete answer to the mystery of love. Danny read the poem he had written out loud:
"Love is respect, love is being there, it's a warm and cozy hug, that shows you sweetly care."
"Love is also laughter, it's to play and build and do, it's holding someone's hand and sharing all your dreams, too."
"Love's an 'I love you' that fills your heart with sun, it's being near or far away, protecting your loved one."
"It's sticking close together, though troubles you may face, because love only grows much stronger in any time or place."
"Love is very simple, found in all the things you do, when you give without condition all the good that is in you."

Danny closed his notebook with a smile. He had solved the mystery of love! And, best of all, he had discovered that love was everywhere: in hugs, in laughter, in helping, in togetherness, and in just being there. Now, every time he saw someone show love, Danny knew he had solved the most beautiful mystery of all. 💖

The sky was still covered in dark clouds ☁️ as the storm began to subside. The last raindrops fell heavily on the leaves of the trees, slipping down to the wet ground. 🌧️ The scent of petrichor filled the air, that unmistakable perfume that arises when rain soaks the earth, mixing notes of fresh grass and wet soil. 🌿 Mike breathed deeply, letting that natural smell fill his lungs and, for a moment, calm the agitation he felt inside. His heart beat with a mixture of melancholy and hope, as he tried to find some solace in the serenity of the landscape for his tumultuous thoughts.

He walked unhurriedly through the almost deserted park, with his hands in the pockets of his jeans. 👖 Each step was a reflection, an attempt to organize the emotions that overwhelmed him. He wore a beige T-shirt under an open denim shirt, somewhat soaked by the rain. He felt the weight of the water on his clothes, but he barely cared; his mind was elsewhere. His short, curly hair was disheveled, and small drops of water clung to his curls. 💧 The cold wind that accompanied the end of the storm made him shrink slightly, but he did not seek shelter. He needed to feel the fresh air on his face, as if it could carry away the worries that weighed him down. It was as if the cold penetrated his skin, numbing his senses and offering him a respite from the emotional whirlwind in which he found himself.

The park, normally full of life, was silent. Only the soft dripping of water falling from the branches and the occasional crunch of leaves under his feet could be heard. 🍂 Mike approached his favorite bench, an old wooden one, located under an imposing oak tree that he had known since he was a child. 🌳 That place had always been his refuge, a space where he could get away from the world and find himself. He noticed that the seat was wet, so he searched in his backpack and found some crumpled newspaper pages. 📰 He carefully placed them on the damp wood before sitting down. He felt tired, not physically, but emotionally exhausted. 😔 He closed his eyes for a moment, allowing the sounds and smells to envelop him, trying to silence the internal voices that kept reminding him of his mistakes.

As he settled in, he watched as the clouds began to dissipate, revealing timid rays of sunlight that were reflected in the raindrops, creating small flashes of light. ☀️ The beauty of the moment caused a pang in his chest. 💓 How was it possible that nature continued its course, indifferent to his pain? The temperature began to rise slightly, leaving behind the cold of the storm and giving way to a pleasant spring breeze. 🌼 However, the cold of loneliness and regret still persisted within him.

Lost in his thoughts, he did not realize that an old man was approaching along the path. 👴 He wore an immaculate white polo shirt and navy blue chinos, with matching shoes that, despite the wet ground, looked spotless. 👞 His completely white beard and hair contrasted with his brown skin, wrinkled by the passage of the years. Curiously, his attire was very similar to Mike's, which brought a slight smile to his face. 😊 A feeling of déjà vu invaded him, as if that encounter was destined to happen.
The old man reached the bench and, noticing the newspaper pages, nodded in approval.
«Good idea,» —he said in a deep but kind voice—. «I never carry anything for these cases.»

Without waiting for an answer, he sat next to Mike, leaving a respectful space between them. Mike watched him out of the corner of his eye; there was something familiar about him, although he could not pinpoint what it was. He felt a strange warmth emanating from the old man, a tranquility that contrasted with his own restlessness.
«The air always smells better after a storm, don't you think?» —the old man commented, looking towards the horizon where the sun was beginning to peek out.
«Yeah, it's... comforting,» —Mike replied, surprised by the familiarity of the voice he heard. He did not expect to talk to anyone, but something about that man invited him to open up.
«Petrichor,» —the man added—. «That's what they call this smell. It has always seemed to me a poetic name for something so simple and yet so complex.»

Mike nodded, turning his gaze back to the park. The sound of the drops falling from the leaves began to mix with the distant murmur of people who were coming out again after the storm. Some children ran in the distance, laughing and splashing in the puddles, while the adults followed them closely. 👫 He wondered at what point he had lost that ability to enjoy the little things, to laugh without worries.
After a few minutes of shared silence, the old man spoke again.
«Sometimes, storms come without warning and take with them more than we expected.»
Mike felt that those words carried a deeper weight. He looked at him directly for the first time, noticing the calm in his small brown eyes. A mixture of sadness and wisdom was reflected in them.

«Many years ago,» —the old man began, without taking his eyes off the landscape—, «I had a storm in my life that changed everything. I was married to a wonderful woman, but our personalities were so different that, over time, we began to drift apart. She was cheerful, spontaneous; I, more serious and meticulous. Disagreements grew, small discussions that became big conflicts. Until one day, after a strong fight, we came to the conclusion that we should separate our paths.»

Mike listened attentively, feeling a pang in his chest. That story was painfully familiar to him. His own memories emerged with force: the arguments, the words said in moments of anger, the emptiness that had remained afterward.
«I'm sorry,» —he said in a low voice, not knowing exactly why he was apologizing.

«Don't worry,» —the old man replied, turning slightly to look at him—. «Over time, I understood that we couldn't blame each other. We were who we were, and that didn't fit. But at that moment, it was hard for me to accept it. I immersed myself in work, determined to achieve the professional success I had always wanted.»

The sun continued to rise, warming the atmosphere. 🌞 The sounds of the park came to life: children's laughter, distant conversations, the song of some blackbird that dared to come out. 🎶 Mike felt small in the face of the immensity of his own mistakes.

«I worked day and night,» —the old man continued—. «I took advantage of every opportunity, every project, every business trip. And I succeeded. I achieved the success I so longed for. But, do you know what I discovered then?»
Mike shook his head, although inside he feared the answer. He felt as if the old man was revealing a truth that he himself had been avoiding.
«That I was alone. I had neglected my friends, my family. My achievements had no one to share with. I tried to reconnect, but many had already moved on without me.»

The old man sighed, and for a moment, his gaze was lost in some distant point. Mike felt a knot in his throat. He thought of the unanswered calls, the meetings he did not attend, the excuses he always made to avoid facing his own feelings.

«I had a friend, Angel,» —he said in a softer tone—. «He was like a brother to me. We shared so many adventures, so many dreams... But in my eagerness to succeed, I stopped calling him, looking for him. One day I found out that he had moved abroad. I wanted to contact him, but it was too late. I would have liked to give him one last hug, to tell him how much I valued his friendship.»

Mike felt a chill. ❄️ He also had a friend named Angel, with whom he had recently lost contact. Could it be a coincidence? Guilt invaded him again. How many relationships had he neglected to focus on what he thought was important?
«Sometimes, we think we will have time for everything,» —the old man reflected—. «But time is capricious.»

The clouds had dissipated almost completely, letting the sun bathe the park with its warm light. 🌅 The blackbirds sang from the branches, filling the air with their melodies. Mike felt that every word of the old man penetrated into the depths of his being.

«There was something else that has always haunted me,» —the old man continued, lowering his voice slightly—. «My bad temper. I was irascible, impatient. I allowed that facet to control many of my actions. I hurt people I cared about, I pushed away others who were trying to get closer. I always thought I could handle it, that it wasn't that bad. But deep down, I knew I was wrong.»

Mike looked at him attentively. He felt more and more affinity with that man, as if he were listening to his own story narrated by another person. He remembered the times he had lost control, the looks of disappointment on the faces of those who loved him.

«Once,» —he said in a softer tone—, «I promised that I would never let my character affect my relationships. But I ended up doing exactly the opposite. And that guilt... that guilt still accompanies me.»
The wind had stopped, leaving a soft breeze that caressed the leaves of the trees. 🍃 Mike decided to open up a little. He felt he needed to share what he was carrying inside.
«It's funny,» —he said—. «I feel like... I understand what you're saying. I too have lost people because of the way I am. Sometimes I think that, if I had acted differently, things would be better.»
The old man nodded slowly.
«It is possible. But you can't change the past. Just learn from it.»
«And how did you get over it?» —Mike asked, with a mixture of curiosity and desperation. He needed to know how to find the peace that the old man seemed to have achieved.
The old man looked at him steadily, with an expression that mixed understanding and compassion.
«Accepting it,» —he replied—. «Understanding that we can't control everything. That pain is inevitable, but suffering is optional.»
Mike remembered those words. They were familiar to him, as if he had thought them himself at some point. He felt a slight liberation in hearing them, as if a burden was lightened inside him.
The old man paused and then continued:
«In short, Mike,» —said the old man, pronouncing his name naturally.
Mike felt a chill. How did he know his name? He was sure he hadn't told him. His eyes widened in surprise. The pieces were beginning to fit together, but his mind resisted accepting it.
«Excuse me?» —he asked, surprised.
The old man smiled slightly.
«Let's just say we know each other better than you imagine,» —he replied, winking at him.
Mike stood up too, feeling a mixture of confusion and astonishment.
«Wait, please. I need to know...»
The old man gestured with his hand, inviting him to calm down.
«Relax. When the time comes, you will understand.»

He began to walk away along the path. Mike noticed something on his wrist: a tattoo that he would recognize anywhere. It was the same one he had, a small phrase in Latin that meant a lot to him. 😮 His eyes widened in surprise. The coincidences were too many.

Mike frowned. The coincidences were too many. He followed him at a distance, observing his movements. The old man walked with a firm step, without the help of a cane, despite his age. A feeling of unreality enveloped him; it was as if he were living a dream.

Upon reaching the park parking lot, the old man approached a car that immediately caught Mike's attention. It was an unusual-looking vehicle, with aerodynamic lines and a stainless-steel body that shone in the sun. 🚘 The doors opened upwards, like the wings of a bird, emitting a soft mechanical hiss.
The old man stopped before getting into the car and turned his gaze towards Mike.
«Remember, Mike,» —the old man said in a clear voice—, «it's no use continuing to deny the obvious.»

Mike opened his mouth to answer, but the words did not come out. A soft hum began to emanate from the car as the old man sat behind the wheel. The headlights came on, and a bluish glow illuminated the interior of the vehicle.

The engine emitted a peculiar sound, a hum that increased in intensity, different from that of any car that Mike had heard before. The wheels began to move, and the car moved away slowly, then accelerated with surprising speed, leaving a trail of vapor behind. 💨

Mike stood there, motionless, with his heart beating strongly. 💓 He looked at his own wrist, touching the tattoo he shared with the old man. A mixture of astonishment, confusion, and a strange peace took hold of him. The pieces finally fit together, and although it was hard to believe, a part of him accepted that reality.
The sound of the blackbirds singing brought him back to reality. 🎶 The park was returning to its usual life. Families strolled, the sun shone high in the sky. But something had changed inside him.

He took a deep breath, letting the scent of petrichor, although fainter now, fill his senses once more. 🌺 He began to walk, this time with a determined step. There were people he had to look for, calls to make, opportunities he did not intend to miss. He felt that a new opportunity was opening up before him, and he was not willing to waste it.

Maybe the old man was right. It was no use denying the obvious. And although he did not fully understand what had happened, he felt a peace that he had not experienced in a long time. A renewed determination drove him.
The future, he thought, was yet to be written. ✍️ And this time, he was determined to be the author of his own story.

Life on the ship had found its own rhythm. Every few months, the colonists would enter hibernation for the star jumps. Trips between stars were long and exhausting, so the best way to deal with them was to sleep while the ship took care of jumping through space. But those periods of lethargy didn't last forever. After each jump, the colonists woke up to perform maintenance on the ship, ensure that the hydroponic crops were growing properly, and continue with the experiments that would be key to survival on Veridia-7. 🌱🛠️

The routine included, for young people like Aura, continuing their training in physical and technical skills that would prepare them for life on Veridia-7. Physical classes were not like those on Earth. They were workouts designed to prepare them to survive on a much more hostile planet, full of unpredictable conditions: low-gravity jumps, races on rough terrain, and the ability to react to sudden changes in the atmosphere. 🏃‍♀️🌪️

Aura did well in some areas, but she didn't stand out like others, especially like Isaac. Isaac, who was already a big, strong kid before entering the program, with his biomechanical enhancements in his limbs, was able to jump great distances, maintain balance in extreme situations, and respond with a speed that surpassed that of most of his companions. His prosthetics were designed to give him a physical advantage, and he didn't hesitate to remind everyone, especially Aura.

—You're here because of your mother, not because of you, —he would say almost daily, every time he saw her stumble or fail in an exercise. —If she weren't one of the officers, you would have been kicked out already.

Aura would remain silent, trying to focus on her exercises, but Isaac's words haunted her. She knew she couldn't tell her mother. If she did, Isaac would be right: she would need her mother to defend her, confirming that she wasn't good enough on her own. So she decided to endure and bear the harassment in silence.
One night, after a particularly hard day, Aura couldn't take it anymore. She went to Zoe's compartments and asked Liam to join them.
—I need your help, —she said firmly as she entered Zoe's room.
—What's wrong?, —asked Zoe, looking up from her holographic tablet.
—I can't go on like this with Isaac. He's making my life impossible, and it's getting worse every day. I want to teach him a lesson, —Aura explained, biting her lip.
Liam frowned. —What do you want to do?, —he asked, although he already had an idea of what Aura had in mind.
—I want us to adjust my enhancements. Not much, just enough so that I can beat him in training. If I can beat him once, he'll stop bothering me.
Liam leaned towards her, lowering his voice. —Do you know what you're asking? It's dangerous. You could get into trouble if anyone finds out.
—I don't care, —said Aura, determined. —I just want to be left alone.
Zoe, always the most cautious, looked at Liam and then at Aura. —If we do this, you have to be very careful. We can't fail.

Liam had always shown an interest in technology, and it was no coincidence. His mothers worked on the development of the software that controlled several of the ship's main systems, including the biomechanical enhancements. From a young age, they had trained him in technical aspects, teaching him how these systems worked and giving him access to simulations. Thanks to this, Liam knew enough to try to handle Aura's modifications.

With their help, the three of them sneaked into the technical room. There, Liam accessed the central system that controlled the biomechanical enhancements. The colonists' modifications were connected to software that regulated their capabilities. The improvements varied depending on the type of prosthesis and the role of each one: some had improvements in their legs to increase resistance in low-gravity conditions, others in their arms to handle heavy tools or perform specific jobs on the surface of Veridia-7. Aura had implants that improved her agility and endurance, compensating for her short stature and physical strength. 💪

Liam adjusted the parameters of Aura's enhancements, slightly increasing her reaction speed and strength. It was a subtle change, but enough to make a difference in training. Aura was confident that this would put Isaac in his place.

The next day, in physical class, everything seemed normal at first. The test consisted of a race through simulated terrain, with obstacles that moved randomly, imitating the conditions they might find on Veridia-7. Aura felt that her body was responding better than usual; her reflexes were faster, her jumps more agile. Isaac, as always, was ready to beat her.
—Today it's going to be a little harder for you to beat me, —Aura said, surprising Isaac with a confident smile.

The race began, and to everyone's surprise, Aura took the lead, hindering Isaac's progress as much as she could, who, irritated, began to push his limits, relying on his enhancements to reach her. However, something started to go wrong. Isaac's prosthetics, when forced beyond their capacity, began to fail. In a desperate attempt to regain his advantage, one of his prosthetics overloaded, emitting a metallic creak before becoming unusable. ⚠️

Both were called before the instructors, where both Isaac and Aura were punished for their reckless behavior. But the worst came later. The failure in Isaac's prosthetics was not an isolated incident. It was soon discovered that the modifications to the system had affected several colonists, whose implants also began to show problems.

Mara was alerted quickly and, after investigating the source of the problem, learned that Aura had been involved in the manipulation of the enhancements. She called her daughter to her office, with an expression that mixed concern and disappointment. 😔
—Aura, how did you even think of doing something like that?, —Mara said firmly, but without raising her voice.
Aura, exhausted by the situation, couldn't help but be honest.
—Mom, Isaac won't leave me alone. He calls me useless, says I'm here only because of you. I couldn't stand it anymore, I didn't want to give him the reason by asking you for help.
Mara looked at her in silence for a few seconds, then sighed.

—I understand how you feel, but you can't solve things this way, —Mara said, in a softer tone. —I know it's difficult, but you can't let what he says define you. Bullying doesn't disappear when you fight it with more violence or with deception. The key is that it doesn't affect you. You must show him that he has no power over you, that you are strong on your own merits, not because of what he says.
Aura lowered her head, but her mother's words made her reflect.

—The most important thing is that you find support in the people who value you. Talk to your classmates, create an environment where he can't win simply because he makes you feel small. It's not easy, I know, but there will always be people who support you if you trust them.

Aura nodded slowly, understanding her mother's message. Mara hugged her before sending her back to her tasks, but now Aura felt that at least she had a plan to face Isaac without resorting to extreme solutions. 💪

The punishment was harsh. Aura, Isaac, Liam, and Zoe were sent to work in waste recycling, a repetitive and exhausting task. Isaac hardly spoke to them, and when his rehabilitation ended, his attitude towards Aura worsened. While he didn't bother her as much in public, the harassment intensified in the moments when they were alone. Whispered insults, malicious comments… Isaac tried to keep her isolated and vulnerable. 😡
