However, something had changed. Classmates began to realize what was really happening. Zoe, always by her side, began to talk to other kids about what Isaac was doing.
—It's not fair what he's doing to Aura, —said Derek in a conversation with the group. —It's clear that she was just trying to defend herself.
Little by little, more classmates began to empathize with Aura. Some, like Sara and Derek, even confronted Isaac directly during a class.
—Leave her alone once and for all. We're tired of your attitude, —Derek blurted out in front of everyone.

Isaac, surprised by the sudden opposition, backed down, but the rage had not disappeared from his face. From that day on, although Isaac continued to make sarcastic comments, he no longer had the same control over Aura. She knew she wasn't alone. Her classmates supported her, and that made Aura feel stronger for the first time in a long time. Not because of the physical enhancements, but because of the network of friendships she had formed around her. 🤝💜

Glupi, the pufferfish, was an expert at many things: puffing up, swimming fast through the corals, and even making huge bubbles! But there was one thing he found very hard… reading. Even though his friends, Tina, Lolo, Estelito, and Crispin, were already reading books and stories, Glupi always fell behind.

Whenever he tried to read, the letters seemed to dance in front of his eyes, and he felt frustrated. “I don’t understand why this is so hard for me!” Glupi would sigh. “I’ll never finish a single story.”

One day, his teacher, Mili the jellyfish, spoke with his parents and decided that Glupi needed a little extra help. “We’ll get you some special tutoring so you can get better,” Mili told him. Glupi agreed, but deep down, he was sad. The lessons would be right after school, which meant he would have less time to play with his friends.
“Guys, I won’t be able to go swimming with you as much anymore. I have to go to reading lessons,” Glupi explained one day, his belly deflated with sadness.
Tina, always so understanding, smiled at him.
—Don’t worry, Glupi. The important thing is that you’re getting better. And we’ll be here for you when you finish your lessons.
But Lolo, the octopus, wasn’t so calm.
—There has to be a way to help you! It’s not fair that we can’t spend as much time together just because you need to learn to read. What if we make it fun?
Glupi raised an eyebrow.
—Fun? With reading? I don’t know, Lolo…
—I’ve got it! Lolo exclaimed, wiggling his tentacles with excitement. —What if we start a book club? That way, we can help you practice, and we can all share the stories we read together!
Tina and Estelito loved the idea right away.
—What a great idea, Lolo! We can meet after school and read together, said Tina.
—And that way, you won’t miss out on our adventures, and we won’t miss out on yours, added Estelito.
Glupi smiled for the first time in days.
—That sounds like a wonderful idea! I don’t want to feel alone with this, and I’m sure reading together will make it easier.

So, the next day, the friends gathered in a quiet corner of the coral reef. Lolo brought a book about an adventurous shark, Tina found one about an explorer turtle, and Estelito brought a story about underwater shooting stars. Glupi, though nervous, brought a very simple story about colorful fish.

At first, it was hard for Glupi to read out loud. The words got tangled up, and sometimes he got frustrated. But his friends encouraged him, helped him with the difficult words, and little by little, Glupi started to feel more confident.
—You did a great job, Glupi! said Tina, smiling. —You’re getting better every day.
—And the best part is that we’re all discovering new stories, added Lolo. —I never knew reading could be so much fun.

Over time, the underwater book club became everyone’s favorite activity. Not only did it help Glupi improve, but it also let them discover magical worlds, exciting adventures, and incredible characters together. And best of all, they did it as a team.
—Thanks, guys, Glupi said one day, after finishing his very first book all by himself. —I never would have done it without your help.
—That’s what friends are for, Glupi, said Estelito with a smile. —Reading together makes the adventures even bigger.
And so, they all continued to meet every week, enjoying the stories and, most of all, the magic of learning and growing together.

Leo and Nora were two ten-year-old siblings who shared a special connection that went beyond a simple fraternal relationship. Often, they could communicate with a look or a small gesture, understanding each other's emotions without needing words. This attunement had allowed them to face multiple challenges together since they were little. They lived with their mother in an apartment in the heart of the city, surrounded by the incessant bustle of cars, streetcars, and people who always seemed to be in a hurry. The sirens of vehicles and the murmur of conversations were the soundtrack of their days.

It was autumn 🍂, and the leaves of the trees that adorned the sidewalks began to turn yellow and red before falling to the ground. The air was filled with the aroma of roasted chestnuts sold at street stalls. The afternoons grew shorter, and the cool wind forced people to bundle up in scarves and jackets.

After a long day at school 🏫, Leo and Nora returned home. Their backpacks seemed heavier than ever, loaded with math 📚 and history books that reminded them of pending tasks. The city traffic surrounded them, and the constant sound of horns and engines was deafening 🚗🚕.
—I'm exhausted 😩 —sighed Leo, dodging a group of people on the sidewalk.
—And we still have the history assignment 📖 —added Nora, looking despondently at her backpack.

They climbed the steps of the old building where they lived, and upon entering the doorway, they were greeted by the warm smell of freshly baked bread 🥖 from the bakery downstairs. That aroma always made them feel a little better.
Arriving at the fifth floor, their mother opened the door with a tired but sincere smile 😊.
—Welcome home! 🏠 —she said, giving each of them a kiss on the forehead—. I've prepared hot chocolate ☕ for you.
The sweet and comforting aroma of chocolate filled the small apartment, intermingling with the delicate scent of vanilla from the candles 🕯️ that their mother lit to create a cozy atmosphere.
—Thanks, Mom ❤️ —they responded in unison, dropping their backpacks by the door.
They sat at the kitchen table, where steaming mugs awaited them. Through the window, the city lights began to turn on, creating a sea of sparkles that competed with the stars ✨.
—How was your day? —asked their mother, serving them homemade cookies 🍪.
—Good 😊 —replied Leo, although his tone of voice said otherwise.
Nora fidgeted with her spoon, stirring her chocolate without tasting it.
—Are you sure? You seem worried 🤔.
The siblings looked at each other. They knew they didn't want to worry their mother, who worked long hours to support the home.
—We're just a little tired 😴 —said Nora finally—. We have a lot to study 📚.
—I understand —nodded their mother—. You know you can count on me if you need help 🫂.
—We know —replied Leo with a weak smile 🙂

After the afternoon snack 🍎, they went up to their room. They shared a space that reflected both of their personalities: posters of movie stars and athletes on Leo's walls, and shelves full of books 📖 and animal figurines 🐾 on Nora's side.

The constant noise of the city filtered through the half-open window. The distant sound of a siren 🚨 and the murmur of people on the street accompanied them as they tried to concentrate on their homework.
—I don't understand these fractions ➗ —complained Leo, flipping through the pages of the book without finding answers.
—And I can't memorize the history dates 🗓️ —sighed Nora.
Frustration grew, and the stress of school obligations weighed on them like a slab.
—Maybe we should rest a little 🛌 —suggested Leo—. Tomorrow we can look at it with a clearer mind.

Nora nodded. They changed and got ready to sleep. Without saying a word, Nora approached Leo's bed and slipped under the covers next to him. It was something they had done since they were little when they needed comfort 🤗.
—Good night, Leo. 🌙
—Good night, Nora. 🌟

The warmth of their bodies and the soft touch of the sheets enveloped them. The lavender scent of the bedding helped them relax, and the distant sound of a street melody 🎶 became a lullaby that lulled them to sleep 💤.

They opened their eyes and found themselves in a completely different place. They were in the middle of a sunflower field 🌻 that stretched as far as the eye could see. The sun shone ☀️ in a clear sky, and a gentle breeze made the flowers sway like golden waves.
—Where are we? —asked Leo, marveling.
—I don't know, but it's beautiful 🌼 —replied Nora, feeling the warmth of the sun on her skin.

The air smelled of fresh grass and honey 🍯, and in the distance, they could hear the singing of birds 🐦. Suddenly, a familiar melody reached them. It was the song their mother used to sing to them when they were little to sleep 🎵.
—Listen 👂 —said Nora—. It's Mom's song.

They followed the sound, walking among the sunflowers that seemed to lean towards them 🌻. The landscape changed smoothly, and now they were in a city park 🌳, the one where they used to play when they were younger. The swings creaked softly, and the aroma of cotton candy and popcorn 🍿 enveloped them.
—Look, it's our park 🏞️ —exclaimed Leo.
They approached the carousel 🎠 where they had ridden so many times. They remembered the laughter 😂, the turns, and the feeling of pure joy.

But then, the sky began to darken ⛈️. Gray clouds covered the sun, and a cold fog began to envelop everything. The sound of the city became distant, and the atmosphere became oppressive. A smell of dampness and wet earth replaced the sweet aromas 🌧️.
—What's happening? 😨 —asked Nora, moving closer to her brother.
From the fog emerged a dark figure, a shadow that seemed to absorb the light around it. It had no defined shape, but its eyes were two abysses that watched them with intensity 👁️‍🗨️.
—I am the Shadow 🌑 —it said with a voice that resonated in their minds—. Bad memories are stronger than good ones, and I will make sure you don't forget them.
The siblings looked at each other with concern 😟.
—We're not afraid of you 💪 —said Leo, trying to sound brave.
The Shadow laughed, a sound that made the air vibrate 😈.
—Really? Let me show you.

The environment changed abruptly. Now they were in a crowded classroom 🏫. The murmur of classmates and the sound of chairs moving surrounded them. At the desk, the math teacher returned their exams with a stern expression 👩‍🏫.
—Leo, Nora, you've failed again 😔 —she said, leaving the papers in front of them—. If you don't improve, I'll have to talk to your mother.
The laughter and comments of the other students made them feel small and ashamed 😓.
—This isn't real 💤 —whispered Nora, feeling a lump in her throat.
—But it feels real 😟 —replied Leo, noticing how his heart was beating hard ❤️.
The Shadow appeared in a corner of the classroom 🕳️.
—These are the moments that define you 🔥 —it said in a cold voice—. Failure, frustration. Good memories are ephemeral, illusions that disappear.
But then, a soft aroma of cinnamon and apple reached them 🍎🍂. Nora remembered the afternoons when her mother made them pie while they listened to their favorite music 🎶.
—Leo, think of something happy 😊 —said Nora with determination 💪.
—The day we learned to roller skate 🛼 —he replied, smiling 😄.
The classroom vanished, and now they were on the boardwalk 🌊, feeling the wind on their faces as they glided on wheels. The laughter and excitement of that day filled them with warmth 🥰.
The Shadow seemed to retreat 👻.
—You can't escape me 😈 —it growled.

The scene changed again. They were in their room 🛏️, surrounded by mountains of books and unfinished tasks 📚. The weight of obligations overwhelmed them, and the feeling of being overwhelmed returned 😓.
—You'll never be able to keep up 📅 —said the Shadow—. You'll always be trapped in stress 😖.

But then, a soft melody began to play 🎸. It was the guitar that a street musician always played on the corner of their street. That sound reminded them of summer afternoons ☀️, eating ice cream 🍦 and enjoying carefree time.
—Good memories are stronger 💖 —affirmed Leo.
—And they will always be with us 👫 —added Nora.
Light returned 🌟, and the atmosphere filled with vivid colors. The aroma of jasmine and the warmth of the sun enveloped them ☀️. The Shadow began to fade, its forms blurring 🌫️.
—This isn't over 😱 —it said before disappearing completely.

In front of them appeared a luminous figure ✨, a woman with hair that shone like the sun ☀️ and eyes that reflected all the hues of the rainbow 🌈. She wore a mantle made of stars that twinkled softly ✨.
—Who are you? 🤔 —they asked.
—I am the Guardian of Happy Memories 🌟 —she replied with a serene smile 😊—. You have shown that joy and love can overcome any darkness ❤️.
—Why did the Shadow attack us? 😟 —asked Nora.

—Because sometimes, worries and stress try to cloud what really matters 🌥️ —explained the Guardian—. But as long as you remember the happy moments and support each other 🤝, you can face any challenge 💪.
The siblings nodded, feeling an inner peace that comforted them 🕊️.
—Thank you for helping us 🙏 —said Leo.
—The credit is yours 🎖️ —she replied—. Never forget that, even in the most difficult times, good memories shine brighter 🌟.
The Guardian raised a hand 🖐️, and a rain of lights fell on them 🌧️✨. They felt sleep envelop them again 💤.

They awoke with the first rays of sunlight entering through the window ☀️. The usual noise of the city began to fill the atmosphere: the murmur of people 👥, the sound of bicycles 🚴, and the beeping of traffic lights 🚦. They looked at each other and smiled 😊.
—Was it a dream? 🤔 —asked Leo.
—I think so, but it felt very real 🌈 —replied Nora.
They got up feeling lighter. The aroma of coffee ☕ and toast 🍞 came from the kitchen.
—Good morning, guys 🌅 —their mother greeted them as they entered—. I have the day off today, would you like us to do something together after school? 🤗
—Yes! 🎉 —they both exclaimed, surprised and excited.
—We could go to the park 🌳 or visit that museum you like so much 🖼️.
During breakfast, they chatted animatedly. The stress of homework seemed to have vanished 🥰.

At school 🏫, although math was still a challenge ➗ and history a maze of dates 📆, they felt more confident. They participated in class and asked for help when they needed it. Their teachers noticed the change and encouraged them 👏.

After classes, they met with their mother and spent the afternoon in the park 🌳. The sun shone ☀️ and the air was full of laughter and cheerful voices 😂👂. They ate ice cream 🍦 and went on the swings, feeling the breeze on their faces 🌬️.
—This is a day to remember 📅 —said Nora, looking at the blue sky 🌌.
—And we'll have many more 🎊 —added their mother, hugging them 🤗.
That night 🌙, before sleeping, Leo and Nora sat by the window, watching the city lights ✨.
—You know? 🤔 —said Leo—. I think we've learned something important 🧠.
—That good memories are always there to help us 💖 —replied Nora.
—And that together we can do anything 🤝.

They hugged 🤗 and got ready to sleep. The distant sound of a melody 🎶 and the murmur of the city accompanied them as they closed their eyes 👁️, knowing that, despite the hustle and bustle and stress, they could always find calm in shared moments and in the memories that shine ✨.
And that’s the end of the story! 🎉
Every kid in the world knows that fairy godmothers exist, but… do they know where they come from, where they live, or how they're assigned? 🌟

Glimmerwood is a parallel dimension to our world where fairies live, beings capable of performing actions that are magical to us. They go about their daily lives using spells: they fly from place to place, bring objects closer with magic, make things happen on their own… all while learning to control their magical powers. ✨
There are many jobs in Glimmerwood, but the most respected one, the one everyone dreams of as a child, is being a “Guardian,” which in our world is known as a “fairy godmother.”

At the Fairy Godmother Academy, students not only learned to cast spells and create enchantments but also to understand human emotions, guide children through their challenges, and protect them from danger. The competition was fierce. Those with the best grades were not only more valued by everyone but also got to choose their charges first.

On the last day of school, when all the future Guardians were choosing their child, Willow was the last one in line. Willow was clumsy with her wand, forgot her spells, and worst of all, had a terrible habit of tripping at the most important moments. However, her heart was as big as her clumsiness, and she had worked incredibly hard to finish her studies. Ahead of her, each fairy chose with a mix of excitement and nervousness, making sure to pick the easiest kids—newborns or toddlers who required little more than sweet sleeping spells and peaceful dreams. But when it was Willow’s turn, only Chloe was left.

Chloe was 12 years old and had already been through several Guardians. They described her as "difficult," a girl who was always in trouble: her grades were bad, she fought with her friends, and things at home weren't much better. Nobody wanted her, but Willow, though a bit scared, bravely accepted the challenge without getting discouraged. "With magic, I'm sure I can fix everything," she thought.

Observing the human world, Willow soon discovered that Chloe wasn't a "difficult" kid because she wanted to be. She had a lot of worries and had never had anyone who truly listened to her. So, she got to work, trying to figure out how she could help her charge.

The first day she tried to help Chloe, she decided to give her a little push at school. Willow cast a spell to help Chloe concentrate better in class, but instead of paying attention to the teacher, Chloe couldn't stop staring at the clock, waiting for the class to end. So things got worse: her grades dropped even more.

Willow didn't give up. She believed magic should always help, so when she saw Chloe fighting with her friends at the park, she cast another spell, this time to make Chloe feel more confident and friendly. The result was that Chloe said exactly what she was thinking... which only made the fights worse.

"This can't be happening!" Willow cried, pulling her hair. Everything was going wrong, and every time she tried to fix things with magic, she just complicated them more. And so, in her desperation, a clumsy flick of her wand made Chloe accidentally see Willow for the first time.
"—Who are you?" Chloe asked, confused.
Willow, flustered, tried to disappear, but she had forgotten how.
"—I'm... I'm... your fairy godmother," she finally confessed. Chloe looked at her in disbelief, and then burst out laughing.
"—Oh, right! My fairy godmother? Then you're the one who's been making everything go so wrong lately!" she shouted, angry.

Willow felt smaller than a speck of dust. She had never wanted to hurt her, but it was true: everything she had tried had only made things worse. So, with great sadness, she hung her head and admitted:
"—I'm so sorry, Chloe. I just wanted to help, but I guess I'm not very good at this fairy godmother thing."
To her surprise, Chloe didn't scold her anymore. Instead, she sighed.

"—My life was already a mess before you showed up, so I guess it's not all your fault," the girl said, sitting down on a park bench. "But if you really are my fairy godmother, why don't we try to do it right?"
Willow looked up, surprised. "—Together?" she asked.

"—Yeah," Chloe replied. "You stop casting spells without asking me, and I'll try harder to study. We'll study for my make-up test together. Just... promise you won't make a frog pop out of my test paper or something."

They both laughed, and so a new chapter began. Chloe worked hard studying for her make-up test, and Willow, for her part, helped her get organized. They spent long afternoons reviewing difficult subjects, while Willow tried to control her magic, casting small spells to keep the books from piling up and the notes always within reach.
During study breaks, Chloe encouraged Willow to practice all kinds of spells and enchantments, helping her become more confident and sharing some really fun times together.

When the day of the test arrived, Willow didn't cheat to make Chloe pass. Instead, she used her magic to calm Chloe's nerves right before she entered the classroom and reminded her that, even though she was invisible, she was always by her side. 😊

Chloe took the test calmly, and, to both of their surprise, she got one of the best grades in the class. She had worked hard, and Willow had learned to use her magic responsibly. Not only had she helped Chloe, but she had also learned that true magic isn't always about spells, but about shared effort and helping each other.

From that day on, Chloe and Willow stayed together, facing every challenge with a smile and the confidence that, while magic could help, the most important thing was teamwork. And so, Willow earned the respect of her peers in Glimmerwood and found in Chloe not just a charge, but also a friend.
And that's the end of this magical tale. 🎉

50.t: The Quest Under the Full Moon
p: In a fantastical world, where the trees had golden leaves and the mountains were made of shimmering crystal, lived a girl named Emily 😊. She was known for her endless curiosity and her big blue eyes that reflected the wonders she saw every day. She lived in a small cabin surrounded by giant ferns that danced in the wind and with a chimney that always gave off a pleasant aroma of burning wood and resin.

Despite how incredible her life was, Emily had made a mistake. A mistake that started as a small lie and then expanded like a shadow. Fluffball, her pet, was as special as the world they lived in 🐾✨. He had long, soft ears like a rabbit, tiny scales peeking out from his fur, and he could emit small, luminous flashes when he got excited. For Emily, Fluffball was more than a pet; he was her adventure buddy, someone who listened without judging and always made her feel accompanied.

But one day, while her friends Sarah, Michael, and David were visiting her at the cabin, Emily noticed their puzzled looks towards Fluffball. They started asking her questions: “Why do you have such a weird animal?” “Aren't you scared it'll become dangerous?” 😟 At that moment, Emily, feeling afraid of rejection and mockery, decided to lie. She told them she was allergic to Fluffball, that he caused her breathing problems at night. She made up that lie thinking it would be best, that maybe her friends would feel more comfortable and stop questioning her.

However, her friends worried about her more than Emily expected. They advised her to get rid of Fluffball for her own good. Sarah said: “We don't want anything bad to happen to you, Emily.” 💔 Michael added: “Maybe it's better if Fluffball finds a more suitable place.” David nodded with concern. Emily, feeling the pressure from her friends and fearing losing their friendship, reluctantly agreed, convinced that it was the only way not to lose them. As she walked toward Shadow Woods, her heart fought against every step she took. Together, they left Fluffball in Shadow Woods, a place she had always avoided. Everything was dark, with trees whose branches intertwined, forming unsettling shadows. There were no goodbyes or caresses, only Fluffball's muffled cry as Emily walked away, feeling as if a part of her was being left behind.

At first, Emily tried to convince herself that she had done the right thing. The house seemed more spacious, cleaner. She tried to fill her days with the same activities as before, but soon that apparent tranquility turned into an unbearable emptiness. The cabin, which was once full of life, now seemed like a cold, silent place. Every corner reminded her of Fluffball: the rug where they used to sit and play, the windows from where they watched the stars together 🌟. Fluffball's absence weighed so heavily in the air that she struggled to breathe. Even the nights seemed longer and lonelier; the warmth of the fireplace was no longer enough to mitigate the cold she felt.

Her friends visited her frequently and told her that she had done what was best for her health. Emily just nodded, smiling weakly, while a feeling of regret grew in her chest that she could no longer ignore. Every time she closed her eyes, she dreamed of Fluffball, alone in the dark Shadow Woods 🌑🌲, and she woke up with tears in her eyes, feeling a painful pang in her chest.

One particularly cold night, when the full moon was reflected in the crystals of the mountains 🌕🏔️, Emily realized she couldn't go on like this. She got out of bed and wrapped herself in a wool coat, determined to follow her heart's calling ❤️. She couldn't allow Fluffball to remain alone in the woods. She promised herself that, no matter how many obstacles she encountered, she would get him back.

The path to Shadow Woods wasn't easy. The moon illuminated her path, but the icy wind cut her face like tiny pins ❄️. The air smelled of dampness, and the ground crunched under her feet, a sound that, instead of calming her, made her feel lonelier. As she approached the woods, the golden leaves of the trees gave way to dark trunks and twisted branches 🌲🌫️. The air became heavy, laden with the smell of decaying leaves and an oppressive silence.

Emily advanced with slow steps, trying not to make any noise. Every rustle of the leaves under her feet sounded like the roar of thunder echoing in the darkness ⚡. She felt fear, yes, but her love for Fluffball outweighed any fear she might have ❤️. As she walked, she faced numerous obstacles: a broken bridge she had to cross by jumping from one wobbly plank to another, an icy river that cut her skin as she crossed it with the water up to her waist 🌊. Each test seemed more difficult than the last, and for a moment, she thought about giving up.

However, every time she closed her eyes, she saw Fluffball's gaze, his joyful sparkle that illuminated her life ✨. That gave her the strength to continue. She came to a small cave, half-hidden among the trees, where the ground was covered in leaves and moss 🍃. She felt a glimmer of hope when she heard a familiar sound: a small, soft, almost imperceptible grunt.

Upon seeing Emily, his droopy ears and sad eyes lit up, and without thinking twice, he ran toward her, enveloping her in a warm embrace 🤗. Emily collapsed to her knees, crying uncontrollably. It was a cry of liberation, of regret, of relief. Fluffball licked her, emitting flashes that illuminated the cave with a soft, warm light ✨. At that moment, Emily realized that she would never again allow the fears and prejudices of others to decide for her.

Back home, Fluffball rested on her shoulders, illuminating the way 🐾✨. Each step back felt lighter, the air warmer, as if the world also celebrated Fluffball's return. When they arrived at the cabin, Emily let him enter first, watching as Fluffball roamed the house, returning to his favorite spots. Everything felt as it should again, full of life and love ❤️.

Her friends came to visit her again, and although they were initially surprised to see Fluffball back 😮, Emily explained the truth to them. She told them how she had felt, how she had lied to herself and to them out of fear. Some didn't understand immediately, but Sarah, her true friend, approached and hugged her, apologizing for not understanding how important Fluffball was to her 🤝.

That night, as Fluffball snuggled beside her and the fireplace crackled softly 🔥, Emily felt a deep peace 🕊️. She had learned the most important lesson: the voices of others could be loud, but only she knew what was in her heart ❤️. And never again, never, would she allow herself to ignore that pure and sincere voice that spoke to her from within. Never, she thought.

51.t: A Walk Through the Woods of Self-Love
p: Once upon a time, in an enchanted corner of the woods, there lived a little rabbit named Pipkin 🐇. His fur was white and soft, like a cotton ball floating in the sky. However, even though he looked bright on the outside, Pipkin didn't feel the same on the inside. He often stared at his reflection in puddles after the rain, searching for something special, but he always found reasons to dislike what he saw: “My ears are too long,” he thought, “My paws are too small, and I can't run as fast as the other rabbits.”
One day, while Pipkin was sitting sadly under a tree, a fox named Finn 🦊 appeared. Although Finn was known for his speed and skill, what truly stood out was his big heart ❤️.
—Hello, Pipkin —said Finn with a warm smile—. Why are you all alone?
—I don't like my reflection —Pipkin replied, looking down at the ground—. I'm not as special as the others.
Finn, with his cleverness and kindness, knew that Pipkin needed more than just comforting words. He decided to show him something that would help. He sat down beside him, ready to lend a paw.

—You know what? —Finn said softly—. I don't run as fast as I'd like to, either. My legs aren't as long as the deer's. But can I tell you a secret? We don't need to be like everyone else to be special.
Pipkin looked up, intrigued by his friend's words. Finn continued:
—When you learn to love yourself, you start to see how valuable you are, just as you are. Sometimes we just need someone to remind us.

Finn took Pipkin for a walk through the woods 🌲🌿. As they walked, they met other animals. Each one had something unique, something that made them shine in their own way, but none of them were perfect. The deer had crooked antlers 🦌, the squirrel was a little clumsy 🐿️, and the owl was always sleepy 🦉.
—Look, Pipkin —said Finn—, they all have something that might not seem perfect, but they are happy, because what makes them unique is what matters most.

Pipkin began to look around with new eyes 👀. He realized that the deer always knew where to find the sweetest fruits 🍎, that the squirrel always found the best hiding spots for nuts 🌰, and that the owl, even though he slept during the day, knew every corner of the forest.
As they strolled, Finn spoke more gently:
—Pipkin, I see you as the bravest rabbit in the forest. Remember that time you helped the hedgehog when it got stuck in the thorn bush? It couldn't have gotten free without you!
—But… my ears are so long —Pipkin replied, still doubtful.
—Your long ears are perfect! —said Finn with a laugh—. They can hear even the softest whisper of the wind. No one else can do that. You warn us of danger before anyone else.
Pipkin was quiet for a moment, thinking 🤔. He had never thought of his ears that way.
—And my short paws? —he asked.
Finn gave him a playful look 😏.
—Short? They're just the right size for hopping through the smallest burrows and finding the most secret tunnels. Not everyone can do that, you know.

As the sun set 🌅, the two friends arrived at a clearing where the moon lit up the ground with its silvery glow 🌕. Pipkin, for the first time, sat in front of a clear puddle and looked at his reflection with a new perspective.
—You know something, Finn? —said Pipkin—. I think my ears aren't so bad after all.
Finn smiled widely 😊.
—That's because when someone loves you, they help you see how wonderful you are, and that's how you learn to love yourself.
Pipkin felt something warm in his chest, a light he had never felt before. For the first time, he looked at himself and smiled 😄.
—Thank you, Finn. Thank you for showing me that I don't need to be like everyone else to be special.
—You don't have to be, Pipkin —Finn replied—. You already are special, just the way you are.

From that day on, Pipkin walked through the forest with more confidence. He started to notice all the things he hadn't seen before: the softness of his fur, the sharpness of his senses, and the bravery he had always had, but was only now beginning to recognize.

Finn continued to join him on his adventures, always reminding him on days when doubt crept back in that the most important thing wasn't to be like others, but to learn to love yourself just as you are.

And so, Pipkin became not only the bravest rabbit, but also the happiest, because he had learned that someone who truly loves you teaches you to see yourself through the eyes of love. And that, that was the most powerful thing of all ✨.

On top of a rugged cliff, next to the deepest and most mysterious sea 🌊, stood a very special lighthouse. From afar, it looked like any other lighthouse, with its tall tower and its light spinning in the night 🌙. But this lighthouse didn't guide ships 🚢. Its light wasn't for sailors or navigators. The lighthouse on that solitary hill had a much more important mission: to guide lost stars back into the sky ✨.

The legend said that, every night, some stars got lost and fell from the firmament, losing their brightness in the great darkness of the sky 🌌. Then, the lighthouse, with its special light, found them and helped them return to their place in the sky ⭐. No one in the nearby town had ever seen a lost star, but everyone believed in the magic of that lighthouse 🏰.

One night, Lily, a curious ten-year-old girl 🧒, was awake in her bed, looking at the sky through the window 🛏️. She was fascinated by the starry sky and often wondered what it would be like to be among the stars ✨. That night, however, she noticed something strange: a star was blinking, but instead of shining brighter, it seemed to weaken until it almost disappeared 🌟.

Lily thought: "That star is getting lost!" Without hesitation, she jumped out of bed 🛌, put on her coat 🧥, and ran towards the lighthouse 🏃‍♀️. She had never been so close to the cliff, but she knew that place held ancient secrets 🔍.

When she arrived at the foot of the lighthouse, she saw that the door was slightly open 🚪. Lily pushed it gently and entered, her heart beating fast with excitement and a little fear ❤️😨. The main room was full of star maps and telescopes 🔭, and in the center, a wise and kind-looking old woman, named Eleanor, was attentively looking at one of the maps 📜.
Eleanor asked: “What are you doing here, little one?”
Lily replied: “I saw a star... a star that was getting lost. I thought maybe you needed help finding it.”
Eleanor smiled with a sweetness that lit up the room, almost like the lighthouse itself 😊✨.

Eleanor explained: “Stars don't always know where they are. Sometimes they feel lonely, other times they lose their way. But with the light of this lighthouse, we guide them back to where they belong.”
Eleanor approached Lily and, pointing to the largest telescope, said to her: “Look through it and find that star you saw.”
Lily looked through the telescope 🔭 and found it right away ⭐. It was small, barely visible, and shining weakly ✨. Eleanor became worried upon seeing it 😟.
Eleanor said: “That star is very far away... it will be difficult for it to return alone. But you, Lily, can help it.”
Lily looked at her confused 🤔.
Lily asked: “Me? How can I help a star?”

Eleanor replied: “Each star has its own light, but when it loses it, it needs someone to remind it that it can shine. You must talk to it, encourage it, and make it remember how important it is in the sky. Only then will it be able to return to its place.”
Lily felt nervous but also excited 😅✨. She had never spoken to a star, but she was determined to try 💪.

Eleanor guided her to the highest tower of the lighthouse 🏰, where the large reflector slowly rotated 🔄. The light, soft and warm, spread across the sky, illuminating the path of the stars 🌟✨. With a gesture of her hand, the old woman pointed to the night sky 🌌.
Eleanor said: “Close your eyes, Lily, and let your heart speak for you. The star will hear you.”
Lily closed her eyes 👀 and, with a mixture of nerves and hope, began to speak 🗣️.

Lily said: “Hello, little star. I know you are lost and that you feel lonely up there, but the sky isn't the same without you. Each star has a special place, and without you, the sky loses a bit of its magic. We are all waiting for you. You have to shine, as you always have.”

The light of the lighthouse began to shine brighter 💡✨, and Lily opened her eyes just in time to see how a beam of golden light enveloped the lost star 🌟💫. The star, which before seemed about to disappear, began to shine more strongly 🌟💖. Little by little, it returned to its place in the sky, radiant and full of life ✨🌠.
Lily smiled, happy to have helped a star find its way 😊🌟.

Eleanor said: “You did well, Lily. Stars, like people, sometimes need someone to remind them how valuable they are. With a kind word and a heart full of light, you can restore the shine to any being.”

That night, as Lily returned home 🏠, she felt a deep connection with the starry sky 🌌. She knew that, although stars might get lost from time to time, there would always be someone willing to guide them back ⭐✨.
From that day on, Lily visited the lighthouse every night 🌙🏰. There weren't always lost stars, but when there were, Lily and Eleanor found them together, restoring their confidence to shine ✨💖.

Time passed ⏳, and although Lily grew up 🌱, she never stopped looking at the sky with the same wonder as that first night 🌠. And every time a star blinked ⭐, she remembered the magic of the lighthouse and the importance of being a light for those who have lost their way 💡❤️.

The Lighthouse of Lost Stars continued to shine, not only on the top of the cliff 🏔️, but in Lily's heart 💖, who now knew that everyone, even the stars 🌟, can find their place when someone reminds them how much they are worth 🌟❤️.

53.t: The Reunion in the Crystal Caves
p: 🌞 One sunny day at the bottom of the ocean, Glupi, Tina, Lolo, and Crispin were happily playing among the corals, as they always did. But something was worrying Estelito ⭐, the starfish. He knew he had important news to share, but he didn't know how to do it.
Finally, Estelito gathered his courage and spoke: — Guys, I have something to tell you... My family and I are moving to another reef, very far from here. 🌊

Everyone fell silent. Glupi's eyes widened, and Tina lowered her head. Lolo stopped moving his tentacles, and Crispin sighed. — You're moving? To another reef? But... why? — asked Tina, her voice trembling.
Estelito explained: — My family found a new home in a larger reef full of starfish. My parents say it will be better for us... but I'm going to miss you all very much. 😔
Glupi, who usually puffed up with excitement, deflated a little with sadness this time. — We're going to miss you too, Estelito. It won't be the same without you.

The days passed, and although they tried to be cheerful, the farewell was difficult for everyone. One day, Estelito and his family swam towards their new home. Glupi, Tina, Lolo, and Crispin said goodbye with tears in their eyes and a tight hug 🤗. Estelito disappeared into the horizon, and the reef felt a little emptier without their friend.

Over time, a new friend appeared on the reef. Her name was Clara 🐚, a shy and smiling clam, who soon joined the group. Clara was fun and a good companion, and although she helped fill the void that Estelito had left, the friends couldn't help but think of him and miss him.
Glupi looked towards the horizon one day and said: — I wonder how Estelito is doing in his new reef.
Tina added: — I'm sure he's made new friends, but I'm sure he misses us too.

One day, the families of Glupi, Tina, Lolo, Crispin, and Clara 🐚 decided to make an incredible surprise: a joint plan for the holidays! 🏖️ They were all going underwater camping near an area full of crystal caves and luminous creatures 🌟.
But the most exciting thing of all was the news that Estelito's family would also be going to the camping trip! The friends would finally meet again! 😃

When the day arrived, they swam to the place of the crystal caves. The walls shone like diamonds under the water 💎, and at night, the glowing creatures danced around, as if they were stars 🌟. It was a magical place, perfect for the holidays.

Upon arriving, they saw Estelito waiting for them with a big smile and his arms outstretched. — Guys! — shouted Estelito, swimming towards them. They hugged so tightly that they didn't want to let go 🤗.

They spent the camping days exploring the caves, playing hide-and-seek with the lights of the sea creatures, and telling each other all the adventures they had lived since the farewell. Glupi told Estelito about Clara, and how she had become part of the group. Estelito spoke about his new friends, but made it clear that no friend was like them ❤️.
Tina said: — This place is amazing, but the best thing of all is that we are together.
Lolo, always thinking of more adventures, had an idea: — What if we do this every year? We can come here camping to reunite! That way, no matter where we live, we'll always see each other.
— Yes! — they all shouted excitedly 🥳.
And so they decided: every year they would meet to camp in the crystal caves, where they would create new memories together, even if their homes were on different reefs.
Even though they lived far away, they knew that they would always find a time and a place to be together, because true friends always find each other.

54.t: Leo Gets Lost in the Woods
p: Once upon a time, there was a seven-year-old boy named Leo, who lived in a small town surrounded by mountains 🏔️. Leo was very curious and adventurous, but also a little impatient and stubborn, especially when it came to listening to grown-ups. He always thought he knew better than everyone else, even though he had just started school 📚.

Leo had a very special pet: a plump, fluffy-haired guinea pig named Mr. Puffles 🐹. Mr. Puffles was quite a character: he was always sniffing around for treats and doing little hops that made Leo laugh uncontrollably 😂. The funniest thing was that Mr. Puffles seemed to understand everything Leo said, as if he were a magical guinea pig ✨. And if anything could make Leo laugh, it was definitely the silly things Mr. Puffles did.

One day, while they were playing in Grandma Margaret's garden 🌸, Leo saw the old woman sitting in her old rocking chair, knitting a colorful scarf 🧶. Grandma Margaret always told him stories about when she was young, about how things were back then, but Leo, as usual, was more interested in chasing Mr. Puffles.
—Leo, come here for a moment—said Grandma Margaret, smiling as she rocked gently in her chair🪑—. I want to show you something important.
—Later, Grandma! Mr. Puffles and I are in the middle of a race!—Leo replied, as the guinea pig scurried playfully between his feet 🏃‍♂️🐹.
Grandma Margaret, with great patience, continued rocking in her chair. She knew that sooner or later, Leo would need her help. In the meantime, she kept knitting peacefully 😊.
The next day, Leo decided to venture into the woods 🌳 with Mr. Puffles, even though Grandma Margaret had warned him not to go alone.
—The woods hold secrets that only grown-ups know—Grandma Margaret had told him the night before. But Leo, as always, didn't pay much attention. He thought he knew better than anyone.
—Come on, Mr. Puffles. Let's go exploring!—Leo said, while the guinea pig nibbled on a leaf it had found on the ground 🍃.

The forest was a place full of life: birds were singing 🎶, leaves crunched under their feet, and the wind whispered ancient stories 🍂. Leo ran from one place to another, delighted with everything he saw. However, as time went on, he realized he didn't remember the way back home 🏡. He had gone so far, without looking back, that the path he had come from was now lost among the trees.
—Don't worry, Mr. Puffles, I know exactly which way we came—Leo said, trying to sound confident 😟.

But as they walked on, he realized he didn't know how to get back. He tried to retrace his steps, but everything looked different. The trees all looked the same, and the forest had grown darker 🌲🌑. Mr. Puffles, in his arms, began to squirm nervously.
—It's okay, Mr. Puffles... we just have to find the path... and that's it!—Leo said, though he was starting to feel scared 😰.

After a long time wandering in circles without finding a way out, Leo finally stopped and sat down on a rock 🪨. He was lost and didn't know what to do. He started to regret not listening to Grandma Margaret. Meanwhile, Mr. Puffles snuggled into his lap, as if trying to comfort him with his warmth and soft squeaks 🐹❤️.
Suddenly, he heard a rustle in the trees. It was Grandma Margaret! She was walking with her walking stick and a flashlight in her hand 🔦. Seeing her, Leo felt a mix of relief and shame 😊😳.
—Are you okay, sweetie?—Grandma Margaret asked with a kind smile 😊—. I had a feeling I'd find you here.
Leo hung his head, ashamed 😔.
—I'm sorry, Grandma... I didn't listen to you, and now we're lost.—Tears started to well up in the boy's eyes 😢.
Grandma Margaret sat down next to him on the rock, petting Mr. Puffles, who hopped right into her lap without hesitation 🐹🤗.

—Don't worry, Leo. It happens to all of us. When I was little, I also thought I knew more than the grown-ups, until I got lost in this very same forest. But the important thing isn't that you got lost, but what you learn from this experience.
Leo looked at his grandmother, surprised 😮.
—You got lost, too?

—Of course, I did. And I learned something very valuable: we grown-ups don't know everything, but experience teaches us to be careful. That's why we tell you not to do certain things—not to bore you, but to protect you. We've been through what you're going through now, and we want to help you avoid making the same mistakes.
Leo nodded slowly, beginning to understand. He looked at Mr. Puffles, who seemed to agree with his grandma 😊.
—I guess I should have listened when you told me...—Leo admitted, looking down 😞.
—It's never too late to learn—Grandma Margaret replied, getting up carefully 🪑—. Now, how about we head home before it gets dark?

Leo stood up quickly, ready to follow his grandmother. This time, he wouldn't run ahead or get distracted. He would follow her footsteps and pay attention 👣👀. As they walked back, Leo couldn't stop thinking about how lucky he was to have such a wise and patient grandma 😊❤️.
That night, when they got home 🏡, Leo went to Grandma Margaret, gave her a big hug 🤗, and whispered in her ear:
—Thank you for coming to find me, Grandma. I promise I'll listen next time.
Grandma Margaret smiled and gave him a kiss on the forehead 😘.
—That's the best promise you could ever make, my dear.

From then on, whenever Grandma Margaret gave him advice or told one of her stories 📖, Leo listened carefully, knowing that behind every word was a reason and a valuable lesson 💡. And, of course, Mr. Puffles was always there, sniffing around for any treats that might fall 🍬.
Moral of the story: Grown-ups have a wisdom that only comes with age. Listening to them protects us and allows us to learn from their experiences to better understand the world 🌟.

The day finally arrived: The descent to Veridia-7 was something Aura had imagined many times during the years spent on the ship. She knew it would be dangerous to cross the atmosphere of such a distant planet, and although the specialists had assured them that everything was under control, the buzzing of the alarms inside the ship reminded her that anything could go wrong.

The seatbelt tightened around her as the ship began its entry into the atmosphere. Around her, other colonists clung to their seats, and some murmured silent phrases. Aura glanced sideways at her mother, who was focused, her eyes fixed on the data panel in front of her. Mara always seemed to have everything under control, but Aura knew that even she must be a little nervous.

Outside the ship, the visors showed an intense glow. The gases that enveloped Veridia-7 collided with the ship, creating sparks and flashes in the most unusual colors Aura had ever seen. Electric greens, bright purples, and silver flashes lit up the sky as they descended. It was beautiful and terrifying at the same time. 🌈⚡

For a moment, Aura closed her eyes and clenched her fists, trying to stay calm. Despite all the training, all the lessons, and everything she had learned about Veridia-7, the fear did not disappear. She felt a pressure in her chest that she couldn't ignore, as if something bad was about to happen.

The ship shook violently, and a couple of screams echoed in the cabin. Aura held her breath as she looked through the window, hoping to see the surface of the planet. But all she saw was the blinding glow of the atmosphere.
"Everything is fine," she repeated in her mind, but she couldn't stop her heart from pounding.

Finally, after what seemed like hours, the shaking calmed down, and the ship emerged through the atmosphere. Before them, a completely new landscape unfolded. Veridia-7 was like something out of a dream: lush forests and towering mountains that stretched as far as the eye could see, dotted with crystal-clear lakes that sparkled under a sky with several moons. In the distance, strange rock formations could be seen that gave the impression of being alive. Everything was so different from Earth that, for a moment, Aura forgot her fear. 🌳🏞️
When the ship finally landed, the colonists let out a collective sigh of relief. They had made it.

However, for Aura, the real challenge was about to begin. Although they had finally arrived on Veridia-7, they were not allowed to explore the planet immediately. The conditions, although similar to those on Earth, were not exactly the same. Veridia-7 had a slightly lower gravity than Earth, which made movements feel a little lighter and bouncier. While that might seem fun, the specialists wanted to make sure that the colonists' bodies adapted gradually. During the trip, they had altered the composition of the air in the ship and adjusted the gravity, but still, they had to proceed with caution. 🌍

The facilities where the colonists were to stay were connected by long corridors made of a material that looked like white tents. Everything was designed to keep them safe and controlled, but for Aura and her friends, those tunnels felt more like a prison. After so many years in space, all they wanted was to breathe the fresh air of their new home, feel the earth under their feet, and explore the world they had waited so long to know.

One day, after finishing classes and assigned tasks at the station, Aura and her group of friends, as usual, wandered through the corridors looking for something to do. Zoe, with her inexhaustible enthusiasm, skipped from one side to the other, while Liam commented on something about the latest readings he had done about the planet's mineral resources. But Aura was distracted, her mind wandering, dreaming of the day when they would be allowed to go outside.
Suddenly, Derek, the most observant of the group, noticed something unusual in one of the joints of the corridor. He approached and, after examining it closely, pointed to a small gap.
—Look at this—he said in a low voice, as the others approached.

There was a small hole, barely visible, but large enough for someone to reach a hand outside. The soil of Veridia-7 was within reach. Aura, without thinking, reached out through the gap and touched the soft texture of the ground. It was damp, cool, and had a slightly sweet smell that was completely foreign to her. 🌿
—It's incredible—Zoe whispered, peering out as well.
But their fascination was suddenly interrupted when Nim, Aura's pet, slipped through the hole in a quick movement. The little hybrid, always curious, was lost from sight in a matter of seconds.
—Nim!—Aura cried desperately, trying to lure her pet back.

Through the small windows along the corridor, they could see Nim moving quickly, exploring with his nose. No matter how much they called him, Nim seemed more interested in the new smells than in returning.
—We have to do something—Aura said, trying to widen the hole with her hands—. I can't let him get lost out there!
—Wait—Zoe said, grabbing her arm—. We can't go out like this, we have to tell the adults.

Aura, reluctantly, agreed. She knew Zoe was right, and the adults had probably already devised some method to rescue Nim without putting anyone in danger. Together, they began to walk down the corridor to seek help. However, just as they were about to turn a corner, an unsettling sound echoed from the outside. It was like a low growl, accompanied by the whisper of something sliding across the ground.

Aura stopped dead in her tracks. Fear ran through her like a chill. She didn't know what it was, but the idea of losing Nim terrified her. Without thinking twice, she turned in the opposite direction and ran towards the hole.
—Aura, no!—Zoe shouted, but it was too late.

Aura threw herself to the ground, forcing her body through the small space of the hole with difficulty. Her heart pounded as she felt the pressure of the material against her hips, but she finally made it. When she got outside, all she could see was the immensity of the alien landscape that surrounded her. Veridia-7 unfolded before her like a dream: the vegetation was dense and vibrant, with shades of green she had never seen on Earth. The plants swayed slightly under a gentle breeze, and the strange rock formations she had seen from the ship were glimpsed between the leaves of the forest in the distance. It was beautiful, but at the same time, unsettling. There was something about this place that made her feel small and vulnerable. 🌿💫

Aura suddenly realized that she had gone out without any equipment. She had neither a weapon, nor a compass, nor even a simple flashlight. Without anything to defend herself or orient herself, the planet, as beautiful as it was, suddenly seemed like a hostile place. The reduced gravity allowed her to move lightly, but after so many months with a roof over her head, this feeling only reinforced the impression that she did not belong there.

With her heart racing, she began to walk, following what she thought might be Nim's trail. The air was fresh, fresher than she had imagined, and the ground under her feet felt strange, soft, almost as if it were breathing under her weight. She called her pet softly, her voice sounding small in the middle of the vastness of the place.
Soon, she began to hear a buzzing. She looked up at the sky and saw several flying probes flying over the area. Her friends must have reached the adults, and now the probes were looking for her.
One of the probes descended to her height, and a hologram was projected in front of her. It was a young man, not much older than her, with an expression that mixed curiosity and concern.
—You have to go back—he said firmly, although his tone was not entirely authoritative—. This place is dangerous, and you're alone.
Aura ignored him and kept walking. She was determined to find Nim, and although she knew the young man was right, she couldn't stop now.
—Listen, you're in a predator hunting area—the young man continued—. There's a dangerous drop in that direction—he pointed to her right—and poisonous plants on the other side. You have to be careful!

Aura kept walking, feeling the fear growing inside her, but also the urgency to find her pet. As she advanced, the colors of the landscape continued to surprise her: the greens were more intense, and the reddish and orange tones of the leaves created a vibrant contrast with the sky, where the moons of Veridia-7 were beginning to be visible.
—Don't let those insects get near you—the young man warned from the probe—. Their bites are extremely painful.

Aura pushed aside a couple of branches as she walked, still calling Nim softly. The young man's hologram followed her, repeating warnings, but she remained focused on what she was looking for. Finally, after a few minutes of walking cautiously, she saw something moving in the bushes.
It was Nim. But he wasn't alone.

Small animals, resembling curious and playful creatures, surrounded her pet. At first, Aura thought they were simply investigating the new intruder, but when she got a little closer, she noticed something unsettling: the small animals were attacking Nim, and he could barely defend himself.
—No!—Aura cried, running towards them, completely ignoring the young man's warnings from the probe.
—Aura, don't get close!—the young man's voice sounded more desperate now—. They're just cubs! If you attack them, you'll attract the mother!

But Aura was no longer listening. She grabbed a stick from the ground and ran towards the small animals, trying to scare them away to save Nim. With a couple of blows, she managed to disperse them, but when she finally paid attention to the young man's words, it was too late.

The sound of a threatening roar made her knees weaken. Aura looked around, searching for the source of the noise, and her heart stopped when she saw the mother. Surrounding the trunk of a nearby tree with her flexible body, an imposing creature stared at her, larger than she had imagined, with intense red eyes and sharp claws that dug into the wood as if it were butter.

Aura, without letting go of the stick, stood in a defensive position, just as she had practiced in classes, but she knew she was not prepared to face such a large predator. The creature watched her, measuring each of her movements. The young man from the probe tried to give her instructions, telling her about the characteristics of the beast, but Aura could only concentrate on the creature in front of her.

The mother attacked. Aura managed to dodge her first attack, but the beast was only testing the ground. With her flexible body and powerful muscles, she could easily knock her down. Aura took a step back, keeping the stick up and watching the fierce animal's agile movements. Her skin was dark gray, mottled by a kind of down that resembled moss, so that if she stood very still she could pass for a rock. Suddenly, the creature lunged at her, aiming directly at her neck. 😨

Just at the last second, a laser beam shot out from the probe, hitting the predator's side, which made it recoil momentarily. The beast let out a roar of pain, but it didn't give up. Aura realized that her uniform had been torn and that she had a deep scratch on her skin, although she barely felt it because of the adrenaline rushing through her body.

The creature lunged again, this time with more fury. Her movement was higher than Aura expected, causing her to lose her balance and fall on a rock in her attempt to dodge. She felt a sharp blow to her ribs and the pain left her breathless. Dizzy and stunned, she could barely move when the mother prepared for the final blow.

At that moment, two figures appeared running from the edge of the forest. The adults. They moved quickly, making noise to scare away the predator. The creature, seeing that it no longer had the advantage, retreated, disappearing into the vegetation.
Aura stretched out face up on the ground, gasping, as one of the adults knelt beside her to help her up.
—Come on, we'll take you back to base—he said in a firm voice, while the other adult picked up Nim, who was also injured but still breathing.

Back at the base, Aura was taken directly to the infirmary. Her mother, Mara, was there, waiting with a mixture of relief and concern on her face. But when she finally saw her, her expression changed to one of disapproval.

—You have been incredibly reckless, Aura—she said, her voice firm but restrained—. I'm glad to have you back, you and Nim, but you can never do something like that again. That creature that attacked you was just one of the small specimens on this planet. You have been very lucky that everything ended like this.
Her mother's words made her feel bad, but she knew she was right. She had been imprudent.

—I can’t believe that my daughter is the most troublesome teenager in this base, Aura. Please, count on me more in the future and allow me to help you solve problems—Mara added as she turned away disgusted and left through the door without giving her daughter time to reply.

Aura felt a pang of important remorse, she felt like a disaster, always causing problems. But a while later, her friends entered the infirmary, very excited. Zoe and Liam surrounded her, filling her with questions.
—Tell us!—Zoe exclaimed—. What was everything like out there? What have you seen?

Aura, still sore but relieved, began to tell them everything, with every detail she remembered. As she spoke, she felt that something had changed. As much as the situation had been dangerous, she had managed to face the unknown.

After this incursion, the officers finally decided that it was time to start letting the colonists know the planet they had been waiting for so long. So they prepared for the first expeditions of non-military personnel. They were finally going to meet Veridia-7 for real.🌍

Once upon a time, many years ago in a cozy little village, there lived a sweet girl known to everyone as Little Red Riding Hood 🌹. Her grandmother had sewn her a cape with a hood in such a beautiful shade of red that the girl loved it instantly. In fact, she loved it so much that she never wanted to take it off.
One sunny morning, her mother said to her:

"Little Red Riding Hood, please go and check on your grandmother. She is feeling a bit under the weather. Take her this basket with some warm soup, fresh muffins, and sweet fruit. And remember, don't dawdle on the way, okay?"

Little Red Riding Hood nodded happily and kissed her mother goodbye. She picked up the basket and skipped into the forest, where the golden sun peeked through the tall trees and the little birds sang, tweet-tweet, chirp-chirp 🎶.

She hadn't gone very far when she bumped into a Wolf 🐺. He caught her eye immediately with his shiny fur and sneaky, clever eyes. The Wolf, who had been watching her from behind a bush, smiled a toothy grin and stepped onto the path.
"Good morning, Little Red Riding Hood," said the Wolf, trying his best to sound friendly.
"Good morning, Mr. Wolf!" she replied, not suspecting a thing.
"Where are you going so happily with that basket?" asked the Wolf, tilting his head as if he were truly interested.
"I’m going to see my Grandma. She isn't feeling well, so I’m bringing her soup, muffins, and fruit," Little Red Riding Hood explained, trusting him completely.
The Wolf’s tummy rumbled, and his mind raced. He loved playing tricks, so he came up with a sneaky plan.

"What a wonderful granddaughter you are!" he said in a silky voice. "But don't you think your Grandma would love a bouquet of wildflowers? It would really brighten her day. Tell you what—I can carry that heavy basket for you so your hands are free to pick the prettiest blooms."
Little Red Riding Hood thought that was a fantastic idea. She handed the basket to the Wolf and wandered off the path to gather colorful, sweet-smelling flowers 🌸.

While she was busy, the Wolf zoomed straight to Grandma's house. He knocked on the door, knock, knock. When Grandma asked who it was, the Wolf pitched his voice high to sound just like Little Red Riding Hood:
"It's me, Grandma! Little Red Riding Hood. I’ve brought you soup, muffins, and fruit."

Grandma opened the door, but as soon as she saw the Wolf, she tried to run! The Wolf was faster, though. He gently shoved her into the hallway closet and locked the door before she could call for help. Then, he put on Grandma’s nightgown and sleeping cap, closed the curtains to make the room dark, and hopped into bed to wait.
A little while later, Little Red Riding Hood arrived at the cottage with her beautiful bouquet. She knocked on the door.
"Come in, my dear," croaked the Wolf, trying to sound like an old lady.
Little Red Riding Hood stepped inside. Seeing her "Grandma" in the shadows, she walked closer to give her the flowers. But something didn't look quite right.
"Grandma, what big arms you have!"
"All the better to hug you with, my dear."
"Grandma, what big ears you have!"
"All the better to hear you with, sweetie."
"Grandma, what big teeth you have!"
"All the better to EAT you with!"

Just then, BANG, BANG, BANG! Grandma started pounding on the closet door and yelling for help. Little Red Riding Hood screamed in fright! Luckily, some Woodcutters who were working nearby heard the noise and rushed toward the house 🪓. They burst in just in time to chase the Wolf away, save Little Red Riding Hood, and unlock the closet to free Grandma.
From that day on, Little Red Riding Hood learned that while it is good to be kind, it is very important never to share her plans with strangers. 🌹

Once upon a time, there was a tremendously vain emperor 👑 who only cared about clothes. He didn't care about other hobbies, the theater, the opera, or even strolling through his gardens, unless it was to show off a new outfit. He was so conceited that he had a different suit for every hour of the day, and whenever someone came looking for him, people would say, "He is in his dressing room."

One day, two men arrived in the city, pretending to be weavers of magical cloth. They claimed they could weave a fabric so extraordinary that not only was it beautiful, but it could only be seen by those who were very smart and excellent at their jobs. Fools, they said, wouldn't see a thing!

The emperor, being so vain, opened his eyes wide. He thought, "If I wear a suit made of that cloth, I will be able to tell who is worthy of their post and who is not." So, without a second thought, he gave the weavers a great deal of gold and the finest threads so they could begin their work.

The two swindlers 😈 set themselves up in a grand hall, where they placed two empty looms and pretended to work day and night. They kept asking for more and more gold and silver thread, but they hid it all in their own bags, moving their hands as if they were weaving.

After a few days, the emperor began to grow impatient to know how his new clothes were coming along, but he was worried about going himself. So he decided to send one of his ministers 💼, a man he trusted deeply and considered very clever. The minister went to the hall, and the swindlers welcomed him politely, pointing to the empty looms and saying:
"Isn't it beautiful? Look at the shine of the threads and the elaborate pattern."

The minister, however, saw nothing at all. Instantly, his heart skipped a beat and he thought, "Could it be that I am a fool, or am I unfit for my office?" To avoid embarrassment, he decided to say nothing and began to praise the "fabric."
"It is incredible!" he said, feigning admiration. "What vibrant colors and what a special design!"

Upon returning to the emperor, he described the invisible suit as if he had actually seen it. The emperor was delighted, but just to be sure, he decided to send another official, someone a little less clever, just to confirm. "If this one sees it, surely I will be able to as well," he thought.

The second official, a less sharp-witted man, looked at the loom and, seeing nothing, thought, "If I don't see this cloth, everyone else will think I am a fool." So, even though he saw nothing, he exclaimed:
"Oh, how marvelous! It is the finest cloth I have ever laid eyes on!"
Hearing the same description a second time, the emperor was convinced the suit must be spectacular. He decided to go see it for himself.

When he entered the hall, the swindlers made a grand ceremony of it, showing him the "suit" and describing the colors and patterns. The emperor saw absolutely nothing, but he thought in dismay, "If they can see it, am I the only one who cannot? That would be a disgrace!" So he faked his admiration and repeated the descriptions his officials had given him:
"Oh, what a beautiful design! What unique colors!"

The day of the grand procession arrived, and the swindlers pretended to dress the emperor with great care. He walked with a majestic step, while his attendants followed behind, holding up the train of the suit that, in reality, did not exist. The people, watching him pass by, did not want to seem foolish and said:
"It is the most incredible suit we have ever seen!"
Suddenly, a little boy 👦 shouted:
"But he doesn't have anything on!"

Whispers spread quickly. First a couple of people, then almost the entire crowd began to say the same thing: "He doesn't have anything on!" The emperor heard them, blushed, and realized they were right, but he couldn't stop now. What a disgrace it would be to admit he had been tricked!

So, making an effort, he held his head high, cut the procession as short as he could, and quickly retreated to the castle, while the townspeople chuckled under their breath. When he turned to look for the weavers to demand an explanation, they were already far away, with their sacks full of gold and their laughter echoing throughout the city.

From that day on, the emperor and his officials learned that you shouldn't get carried away by the fear of what others think, because you might end up being fooled. Being honest with yourself and standing up for the truth, just as the little boy did in his innocence, does not make us any less. Sometimes, being truthful and defending what we believe in, even if it isn't popular, is what truly makes us strong and brave.

58.t: Lily Learns to Care for Her Big Smile
p: Once upon a time in the jungle, there lived a playful little tiger named Lily 🐯, who loved exploring and playing with her friends. One day, her mommy tiger said, "Lily, it's time to visit the dentist!"

Lily was surprised. A dentist? She had never visited one before. When they arrived, Dr. Lila 🐵, a friendly monkey with a big smile and kind eyes, was waiting. "Welcome, Lily! Today we're going to learn how to take care of your teeth so they stay strong and healthy."

Dr. Lila showed her some flexible twigs and explained, "These little twigs are perfect for rubbing your teeth. You should rub gently in circles, so your teeth get nice and clean." Lily, excited, took a twig and started practicing, watching her teeth become brighter and cleaner.

Afterward, Lily asked, "And what's that stuff my mommy uses to make her breath smell good?" Dr. Lila handed her a paste made of mint and other fresh plants 🌱. "Remember, this paste doesn't clean, but it freshens your mouth. The important thing is to rub your teeth well with the twig. If you use it, you can make fun bubbles while you clean!" added Dr. Lila with a smile. Lily tried a little of the paste and loved the freshness in her mouth.

"For teeth that are very close together," continued Dr. Lila, "you can use this special floss." She showed her a strong thread made from the most resistant spider's silk 🕸️, perfect for cleaning between teeth. Lily tried the floss, carefully passing it between her fangs, and felt how it left everything clean. "You'll need to practice a little more at home with the floss, but you'll see how comfortable it is when you have your teeth nice and clean."
Finally, Dr. Lila reminded her, "You should do this at least twice a day, and especially before bed, so your smile is always ready for new adventures."

From then on, Lily never forgot her routine. Every morning and night, with her twigs, her plant paste, and her spider silk, she took care of her big smile. Now she was the little tiger with the shiniest teeth in the whole jungle! 😁✨

Leo looked from side to side when they arrived at the station, searching for the modern train he had imagined they would ride. But his aunt pointed in another direction: toward an old-fashioned looking train, the kind you don’t see very often anymore. He frowned, a little disappointed. Why couldn't they be on a fast, quiet train? But his aunt smiled at him and explained that the trains from long ago had something special, a magical sound that the new ones no longer make, a sound like tum-tum, tum-tum, that invited passengers to relax. 🚂

A little curious now, the boy let his aunt lead him onto the train. They found their seats, and as they settled in, he looked out the window at the other passengers getting on, slowly finding their places too. He could hear bits of conversations, soft laughs, and the rumble of suitcases being placed in the overhead compartments. The platform, which had been crowded just moments before, was starting to grow quiet. Finally, with a little jolt, the train began to move. That tum-tum, tum-tum sound his aunt had told him about filled the car, like a song for all the travelers. 🎶

Soon, they left the city behind, and the buildings began to disappear. Leo rested his head against the back of the seat and watched the landscape roll by. They passed a field full of red poppies, like little spots of life in the vast green space, and then fields of sunflowers that seemed to greet the train as their yellow heads tilted toward the sun. 🌻 Farther on, he saw a tractor working slowly in a field, kicking up little clouds of dust.

The sky was clear, with just a few playful clouds moving slowly. The boy started to imagine shapes in them: first a big, fluffy bear, then a floating island in the sky, and later, a giant fish that seemed to be swimming in the breeze. 🐟

The train kept its rhythm. A group of birds perched on the power lines. He watched them, how they organized themselves all in a row, as if they were getting ready for something important. Suddenly, they all took off at the same time, a great flock that drew patterns in the air before landing again. The birds were practicing for their own journey, one even longer than Leo’s. 🕊️

Meanwhile, the sunlight streamed softly through the windows, wrapping everything in a gentle warmth. The passengers' conversations grew quieter and quieter, almost like a whisper that went along with the steady tum-tum, tum-tum of the train. The temperature was pleasant, as if someone had designed the train car to be a perfect, cozy little corner.

Leo then noticed how heavy his eyelids were becoming, slowly closing bit by bit. He rested his head on his aunt's lap, and she began to stroke his hair, gently weaving her fingers through the strands, slowly and tenderly. The tum-tum, tum-tum of the train lulled him, and the world outside, with its fields, its clouds, and its birds, was wrapped in a blanket of calm. Without even realizing it, the boy drifted off to sleep, held by the gentle rhythm of a journey that invited him to dream. 😴
You watch the sun as a new day is born. 🌞 Its warm rays fill the forest with joy.
You wanted to see the sunrise before all the animals woke up, 🌳 the light gently touching the treetops.
Beyond the river, flowers are opening. 🌸 With the cool water nearby, their sweet smells blend together.
Every now and then, a leaf falls. 🍂 It makes a soft sound as it touches the grass.
The most wonderful thing is the quiet. 🌿 The whisper of the wind is the only sound.
You can feel that the birds aren't singing yet. 🐦 The forest is silent, sinking into peace.
There is no rush; everything happens calmly. 🍃 The leaves whisper, and the moment just flows.
Have you ever imagined a place so peaceful, where every breath feels full and happy?
And all the while, the clouds drift by. ☁️ They draw fluffy, cotton shapes in the sky.
The little creatures are still asleep. 🐇 Dreaming sweet dreams in their warm nests.
That's how the quiet morning passes. 🌾 The dew refreshes every silvery leaf.
You are in a place where peace reigns. 🌳 All of nature is speaking in silence.
Here, in this quiet corner. 🍃 Time stands still; everything is paused.
You always find harmony and beauty here. 🌼 The songs of birds fill the air with purity.
Because treasures are hidden in the silence. 🌲 Textures and smells that are worth more than gold.
Even if you don't notice, every detail counts. 🍂 The wind on your skin is like a gentle, encouraging touch.
There is no need for words or noise. 🌾 Your senses are awake, your heart is bright.
Simple things become extraordinary. 🌸 When you pay attention, everything is important.
You make memories with what's around you. 🌿 A flower, a scent, a breeze that wanders by.
You sink into a feeling of well-being. 🌞 Everything hums in harmony, with nothing to disturb it.
Feel this serene moment. 🌬️ The tranquility of the woods, the atmosphere so full.
Such is the beauty of this magical place. 🌼 The colors and sounds create a fantastic world.
And every feeling connects you to the earth. 🍃 The scent, the murmur, the breeze all around.
It's as if you have always belonged here. 🌳 Every detail invites you to stay forever.
You are part of this incredible landscape. 🌿 When you close your eyes, you can truly feel it. 😊

Once upon a time, there was a boy so tiny that everyone called him Little Chickpea, because he was just as small as a garbanzo bean. But even though he was pint-sized, Little Chickpea was very brave and loved going on big adventures outside.
One day, his mom said to him, "Little Chickpea, please be very careful and don't wander too far."
But Little Chickpea was curious. He marched through the fields, singing a loud song so nobody would accidentally step on him:
"Tip-tap, toe! Watch where you go! Look at the ground, look all around, Don't squash Little Chickpea down on the ground!" 🎶

Suddenly, the sky turned gray and it began to rain 🌧️. To stay dry, Little Chickpea scrambled under a giant cabbage leaf 🥬. It was the perfect umbrella! But just then, a hungry ox wandering through the field saw the delicious cabbage. Chomp! The ox ate the cabbage in one big bite, completely unaware that Little Chickpea was hiding inside! Oh no! 😱
From deep inside the ox’s tummy, Little Chickpea didn't lose hope. He started shouting as loud as his tiny voice would allow so someone would find him:
"Mom! Dad! Can you hear me? I’m in the belly of the ox, where it never rains and it never snows!" 🌦️
His parents, who were very worried, were out searching for him, calling his name: "Little Chickpea! Where are you?"
And Little Chickpea shouted back from inside the ox: "I'm in the belly of the ox, where it never rains and it never snows!" 🌧️❄️
Suddenly, Little Chickpea's dad had a bright idea 💡. He walked up to the ox 🐂 and gave it a little tickle right on the nose. The ox's nose twitched, and he couldn't stop a giant sneeze coming on...
Little Chickpea went flying out of the ox's mouth and landed safely on the soft grass. He was safe and sound! His parents scooped him up and gave him a gigantic hug 🤗.
And that is the end of the story—snip, snap, snout, this tale is told out! 🎉

Once upon a time, there was a spoon named Chelsea 🥄, a spoon with a life full of adventures and memories. She wasn't like the other spoons; she had a special sparkle ✨ and enjoyed every moment she fulfilled her purpose. Her favorite dish, without a doubt, was star soup ⭐️. There was nothing she liked more than diving into that sea of little stars and feeling how her metallic shine reflected the warmth of the soup.

But there were two things that made her enjoy her work even more. The first was the long, bushy mustache of some diners 🧔. When the mustaches peeked over the edge of the spoon, they gave her irresistible tickles, as if her steel were laughing inside. The other was when someone slurped the soup noisily 🥄🔊. Chelsea felt the vibration run through her surface and gave her such a fun sensation, that she couldn't help but think that each slurp was like a little party 🎉.

Chelsea worked in the restaurant of a fancy hotel 🏨, and every day she served with dedication and professionalism. Although life there was interesting, she felt that, perhaps, one day, something new would surprise her.
